¿Cómo rezamos?
passages.text: Si el musulmán quiere realizar la oración debe hacer los pasos siguientes:

passages.heading: Las condiciones de la oración:
passages.text:
Para realizar la oración, se debe cumplir ciertas condiciones que son:

- **La purificación:** incluye la purificación del cuerpo y del lugar de todas las impurezas e incluye también la ablución menor (wudu) y mayor (ghusl).
- **Cubrir la parte íntima (A’ura) que es todo lo que se cubre en presencia de la gente.** En cuanto a la parte íntima del hombre que tiene que cubrir al rezar es entre el ombligo y las rodillas, mientras que la mujer debe tapar todo su cuerpo salvo el rostro y las dos manos.
- **Dirigirse hacia la Quibla que es la dirección hacia la Kaaba honrada que se encuentra en la Meca,** el orante debe dirigirse hacia ella al rezar.
- **La llegada del tiempo del rezo:** no se debe rezar antes del tiempo de la oración, ni se debe retrasarla hasta que pase su tiempo, y lo mejor es realizarla al inicio de su tiempo prescrito.

Leer más

Mira este video sobre cómo realizar la oración, producida por el centro de Usul.

Escanea el código de barras para ver el video

passages.heading: Las cinco oraciones:
passages.text:
Al-láh -Enaltecido y Exaltado sea- prescribe a sus siervos rezar cinco oraciones al día que son:

| | El inicio de su tiempo | El fin de su tiempo | Sus unidades (Rak’as) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Salat al Fayer (el rezo del alba) | el alba. | el amanecer. | 2 |
| Salat ad-Duhur (el rezo del mediodía): | la puesta del sol (es decir cuando el sol empieza a dirigirse hacia el oeste a mediodía). | cuando se iguala la sombra de una cosa a su longitud. | 4 |
| Salat al- Asr (el rezo de la tarde): | cuando se iguala la sombra de una cosa a su longitud. | el atardecer. | 4 |
| Salat al Magrib (el rezo del ocaso): | el atardecer. | el crepúsculo. | 3 |
| Salat al ‘Isha (el rezo de la noche): | el crepúsculo. | la medianoche. | 4 |

passages.heading: ¿Cómo realizar la ablución menor (wudu)?
passages.text: Si el musulmán quiere realizar la ablución menor debe realizar los pasos siguientes:

passages.heading: As-Salat (el rezo ritual).
passages.text:
11. Se dirige con su cabeza hacia la parte derecha diciendo “”As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatulláh = que la paz y la misericordia de Al-láh sean con ustedes”” luego a la izquierda diciendo lo mismo. Y de este modo termina su oración.

Se realiza de esta manera cuando se trata de una oración de dos unidades como la del alba y del viernes. Pero si consta de tres unidades como la del Maghreb o de cuatro como la del Dhuhr, Asr e Isha en este caso cuando termina el primer tashahud, luego sigue con las unidades que faltan igual que la primera unidad pero solo recita la sura de Al Fatiha, luego se sienta como la sentada después de la segunda unidad y recita el segundo tashahud y la oración abrahámica, luego saluda y así se termina la oración.

Tercero: Convertirse al Islam es el camino a la felicidad en esta vida y a la salvación en la otra vida, ya que no se salva en la otra vida sino quien al recibir el mensaje del profeta Muhammad -que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él- haya creído en él y le haya seguido, Al-láh-Enaltecido sea- dice: {{Q:3:85}} Corán (3: 85)

El profeta -que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él- dijo:» Juro por Aquel que posee mi alma en Su mano que, si una persona de este pueblo sea judío o cristiano, oye mi Mensaje y muere sin haber creído en él, será de la gente del infierno». Narrado por Muslim 153.

Cuarto: El Islam responde con respuestas evidentes a mis preguntas: ¿Por qué estoy en esta vida? ¿De dónde vine? y ¿A dónde iré después de la muerte?

passages.heading: Salat al-Yumu’a [La Oración del Viernes].
passages.text:
- Al-láh -Enaltecido y Exaltado sea- prescribió la realización de la oración del viernes con condiciones y modos precisos, y que sustituye la oración del Dhuhr para este día.
- Los musulmanes se reúnen en la mezquita para realizarla, escuchan los dos sermones del imam, luego rezan con él dos unidades donde el imam recita el Corán en voz alta.
- Está permitida la ablución mayor (ghusl) para asistir a la oración del viernes y asisitir pronto. Y no está permitido ausentarse sin excusa, quien no asiste a la oración del viernes debe realizar la oración del Dhuhr cuatro unidades y no recitar el Corán en voz alta.
- La oración del viernes no es obligatoria para la mujer ni para el viajero.

passages.heading: Segunda pregunta
passages.text:
#### ¿De dónde vinimos? y ¿Por qué?

El Islam explica que el ser humano fue creado de un barro con lo cual Al-láh creó a Adán, el padre de toda la humanidad. Al-láh -Enaltecido sea- dice: {{Q:23:12}} Corán (23: 12).

El objetivo por lo cual fue creado el ser humano es la adoración a Al-láh -Enaltecido sea- Quien no necesita esta adoración, Glorificado y Exaltado sea.

**Adán**
Al-láh nos ha contado en el Corán la historia de la creación y el inicio de la enemistad del Satanás hacia al ser humano, véase la exégesis del capítulo de Al Baqara (la vaca), las aleyas (30-39).

Al-láh -Enaltecido sea- dice: {{Q:51:56}} Corán (51: 56).

passages.heading: ¿Cómo rezamos?
passages.text:
1. Tener la intención para la oración en su corazón (sin pronunciarla).
2. Ponerse de pie, dirigiéndose hacia la Quibla, levantando sus manos cerca de sus hombros o sus orejas diciendo: “”Al-láhu Akbar””.
3. Poner su mano derecha sobre la izquierda, luego decir la súplica de apertura de la oración (Istiftah) como:”””Glorificado seas Al-láh te alabamos. Bendito sea tu nombre y elevada sea tu majestad. No hay dios sino Tú””.Luego dice:(“”A’udhu bilahi mina shaytanir-rayim”” “”bismilahir-rahmanir-rahim””) es decir (“”Me refugio en Al-láh del maldito Satanás””, “”En el nombre de Al-láh el Clemente el Compasivo””).
Luego recita el capítulo de Al Fatiha y dice “”Amin”” (amén) después de acabarla, es decir: “”Oh Dios mío acepta mis súplicas””Luego recita algo que ha memorizado del Corán, aunque sea una sola aleya.
4. Levanta sus manos hasta sus hombros u orejas diciendo «»Al-láhu Akbar»» luego inclina su espalda poniendo sus manos sobre sus rodillas, estando su espalda y cabeza perpendiculares con sus piernas y dice durante su inclinación: «»Subhana rabial Adhim= Glorificado sea mi Señor Grandioso»» tres veces.

passages.heading: As-Salat (el rezo ritual)
passages.text:
5. Al levantar su cabeza y elevando sus manos cerca de sus hombros dice ‘”Samia’ Al-láhu liman hamidahu= Al-láh escucha quien lo alaba’” y al estar de pie dice: ‘”Rabana walakal Hamd= Señor mío a Ti pertenecen las alabanzas’”.

6. Luego prosterna poniendo su frente, su nariz, las palmas de sus manos, sus rodillas y las puntas de los dedos de sus pies en el suelo diciendo «»Subhana Rabial A›ala= Glorificado sea mi Señor el Altísimo»» tres veces.

passages.heading: ¿Por qué realizamos la oración?
passages.text:
Rezamos porque la oración es una adoración prescrita por Al-láh para todos los musulmanes.

Entre las sabidurías y los beneficios de la oración citamos:

- Es el lazo entre el musulmán y su Señor.
- Fortalece la voluntad y la perseverancia del musulmán.
- Libera el alma de las preocupaciones de la vida mundana.
- Mejora la conducta, y aleja a la persona de los vicios.

passages.heading: Los actos que exigen la ablución menor:
passages.text:
Lo que exige la ablución menor son los actos que al realizarlos se debe estar puros y no se puede realizarlos sino al purificarse, y son:

Al Hadaz: es un estado moral del hombre que impide la realización de la oración antes de purificarse y no es algo tangible como las inmundicias, y es de dos tipos: uno exige la ablución menor (wudu) y el otro exige la ablución mayor (ghusl).

1. La oración.
2. La circunvalación alrededor de la Kaaba.
3. Al tocar el Libro del Corán.

passages.heading: ¿Cómo realizar la ablución menor (wudu)?
passages.text:
1. Debe tener la intención de la ablución menor en su corazón y decir: ““En el nombre de Al-láh””.
2. Lavarse las manos con agua empezando por la derecha.
3. Limpiar la boca enjuagándola con agua y echándola, a lo que se le llama el enjuague.
4. . Limpiar la nariz poniendo agua con la inhalación, y luego sacarla de la nariz.
5. Lavarse toda la cara, su límite verticalmente es desde el inicio del cabello encima de la frente hasta el fin de la barba incluido el pelo de la barba si existe, y horizontalmente entre las dos orejas.
6. Lavarse las manos desde las puntas de sus dedos hasta los codos, empezando con la mano derecha.
7. Con las manos mojadas, pasarlas sobre la cabeza empezando por el inicio de la cabeza hasta la nuca, luego regresar con sus manos al inicio de la cabeza.
8. Pasar los dedos mojados sobre sus orejas limpiando cada una con el índice por dentro, y con el pulgar por detrás.
9. Lavarse los pies hasta los tobillos empezando por el pie derecho.

passages.heading: La cantidad de veces del lavado de los miembros de la ablución menor:
passages.text: La sunna en la ablución menor (wudu) es lavarse cada órgano o parte tres veces salvo la cabeza y las orejas una sola vez, pero también es suficiente lavarlas una sola vez con la condición de lavarse el órgano por completo.

passages.text: 10. Después de la segunda prosternación en la segunda unidad se queda sentado igual que su posición entre las dos prosternaciones y dice: At tahiiátu lillahi uas salauátu uat taiibátu as salámu ‘alaika aiiuhan nabíiu ua rahmatullahi ua barakátuhu as salámu ‘alaina ua ‘ala ‘ibádillahi salihín ash-hadu an la iláha il lallahu ua ash hadu anna muhammadan ‘abduhu ua rasúluh “Las salutaciones, los actos de devoción y las buenas obras son para Al-láh. La paz, misericordia y bendiciones de Al-láh sean para ti ¡Oh Profeta! La paz sea sobre nosotros y sobre los siervos virtuosos de Al-láh. Atestiguo que no hay otra divinidad salvo Al-láh y atestiguo que Muhammad es Su Siervo y Mensajero.»» Y esto se llama el primer Tashahud. Luego dice: {Al-láhuma Sali ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muahammad, kama salayta ala ibrahim wa ala ali ibrahim inaka Hamidun Mayid. Wa barik ala Muahmmadin wa ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta ala ibrahim wa ala ali ibrahim inaka Hamidun Mayid} (¡Oh, Al-láh! Exalta a Muhammad y a la familia de Muhammad como exaltaste a Abraham y a la famila de Abraham, ciertamente eres loable y glorioso. ¡Oh, Al-láh! Bendice a Muhammad y a la familia de Muhammad como bendijiste a Abraham y a la familia de Abraham, ciertamente eres loable y glorioso.) Y ésta se llama la oración abrahámica.

passages.heading: Who Are We?
passages.text:
He has provided him with an innate readiness to do good or evil but has at the same time furnished him with such cognitive tools as the innate human nature (*fitrah*) and the intellect to discern good from evil.

He has also given him free will to be responsible for his own choices and actions.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: People have always pondered the big questions of human existence: Where did we come from? Why are we here? Where do we go after death? Islam provides definitive and conclusive answers to these questions which arise in the heart of every reflective human being.

passages.heading: Lesson 1
passages.text: ## Islam and the Great Questions of Human Existence

passages.heading: Who Are We?
passages.text:
Islam defines ‘man’ as one of Allah’s many creatures. The Almighty has honoured man and favoured him greatly above many other creatures, and subjected many of them to him so that he may benefit from them to perform the duties required of him during his life. The Almighty says, {{Q:17:70}} (Surat Al-Israa’, 17:70).

Allah Almighty has made in man some kind of likeness to:

> The angels are among Allah’s creatures. The Almighty created them from light and with a natural predisposition to worship and obey Him. They are His honoured servants who never disobey His orders but always do as they are commanded. There are a great many of them, but only Allah knows their number.

- the angels in their purity and worship.
- the devils in their ingratitude and disobedience, and
- the animals in their satisfying their whims and desires.

passages.heading: The Blessing of Right Guidance
passages.text: Whoever knows the purpose of his existence and the outcome that awaits people on the Day of Resurrection is bound to realise that the greatest blessing that Allah has ever bestowed upon people is that of guidance to the true religion and righteous deeds. Therefore, Allah Almighty has enjoined His servants to ask Him in their prayer to guide them to the straight path—the religion of Islam which leads to Allah’s good pleasure.

passages.heading: The Second Question
passages.text:
#### Where Did We Come from, and Why Are We Here?

Islam explains that the origin of man’s creation is clay from which Allah Almighty created Adam, the father of all mankind: {{Q:23:12}} (Soorat Al-Mu’minoon, 23:12) Allah created mankind for the sole purpose of worshipping Him even though He is Self-Sufficient and does not stand in need of their worship. The Almighty says, {{Q:51:56}} (Soorat Adh-Dhaariyyaat, 51:56) A secondary reason for human existence is for man to settle on the earth and thus build civilisation, establish justice and spread good. The Almighty says, {{Q:11:61}} (Soorat Hood, 11:61).

**Adam**
Allah tells us in the Qur’an the story of Adam’s creation and how Satan’s enmity towards him started. See the interpretation of Verses 30-39 in Soorat Al-Baqarah.

passages.heading: The Third Question
passages.text:
#### Where Do We Go?

The Qur’an teaches that every human being will die and, following his death, the stage of doing deeds will end and the stage of judgement and recompense will begin. The Almighty says, {{Q:39:30-31}} (Soorat Az-Zumar, 39:30-31).

Thus when a person dies, he moves on to a stage in which he will be asked about his religion and will be repaid according to his deeds. The Almighty says, {{Q:3:185}} (Soorat Aal-’Imraan, 3:185).

When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah will raise the dead from their graves for judgement and recompense. The believers will be rewarded with Paradise, while the unbelievers will be punished in Hell. The Almighty says, {{Q:42:7}} (Soorat Ash-Shooraa, 42:7).

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: Make a comparison between how you viewed the meaning of your existence before and after embracing Islam.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text:
Settling on earth and building a civilization on it is one of man’s roles in this life. To enable him to perform this great and challenging task, Allah has provided him with such physical and mental make-ups to help him perform this role. Explain how, of all other creatures, only man can settle on earth and build a civilization?

Mention some of the practical implications of getting to know the ultimate fate of people after death?

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
A man's *'awrah* that must be covered extends from the navel to the knees. A woman must cover herself entirely in the presence of men not related to her; as for men to whom she is related and is forbidden to marry, such as her father, son and brother, she may appear before them as she would normally do in front of other women, showing such parts of her body as the face, hair, the neck and feet.

- Clothing that reveals the *'awrah* and does not conceal it
- Clothing that involves dressing like or imitating the opposite sex, such as when men dress like women and vice versa.
- Clothing that is worn with an air of pride and conceit
- Extravagant clothing
- Men are particularly forbidden to wear silk clothing or adorn themselves with gold or silver jewellery.
- Clothing that involves imitation of the dress traditionally worn by non-Muslims and specific to a certain religion, such as the type of clothing worn by monks and priests

passages.heading: *Soorat Al-Kaafiroon* Explained
passages.text:
{{Q:109:1-6}}

“Say: Unbelievers!”

Say, Messenger, to those who disbelieve in Allah and His Messenger: You unbelievers.

“I do not worship what you worship”

I do not worship the false gods, such as idols, that you worship.

“nor do you worship what I worship”

nor do you worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

“I will never worship what you worship”

I will never worship the false gods that you worship.

“nor will you ever worship what I worship”

nor will you ever worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

Al-kaafir: The person who does not proclaim pure monotheism and does not follow the divine message Prophet Muhammad ﷺ has brought.

“You have your religion, and I have my religion”

You have your religion to which you adhere, and I have my religion to which I adhere.

passages.heading: How Do We Pay *Zakaat* Due on Cash?
passages.text: A Muslim pays *zakaat* due on his cash once a year. 2.5% of its value must be given out as *zakaat*.

passages.heading: Why Do We Pay *Zakaat*?
passages.text: We pay *zakaat* in compliance with the command of Allah who has enjoined us to pay it.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: The clothes we wear are some of the countless blessings Allah has bestowed on us. The Qur’an states, {{Q:7:26}} (Soorat Al-A’raaf, 7:26).

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: Since ancient times, people on this earth have led different lives with varying living standards. Some are very well-to-do; others are destitute and can barely find anything to eat. This is one of Allah’s ways in this universe. Islam enjoins the wealthy to pay a certain percentage of their wealth to the poor to relieve them of the burden of poverty and urges Muslims to spend more of what they are required to spend, promising them great rewards for doing so both in this life and after death. It also urges them to give charity to the needy at all times and on every occasion and encourages them to feed the hungry and clothe the naked in order for the Muslim community to become close-knit, just as Allah Almighty wants it to be. In this lesson, we are going to learn about the Islamic ruling on *zakaat*, the manner of paying it and the types of wealth upon which it is due.

passages.heading: The Pillars of Islam
passages.text:
Islam is built on five pillars:

Every Muslim must strictly adhere to these pillars to ensure he is practising Islam in full; negligence in one of these pillars is bound to render the way you practise Islam deficient.

1. The two testimonies of faith: To bear witness that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is His His Messenger
2. Establish the prayer: A Muslim must pray five times a day. These prayers will be explained in due course.
3. Paying zakaat
4. Fasting in the month of Ramadaan
5. Making the pilgrimage to Allah’s House

passages.heading: Islamic Rulings Pertaining to Menstrual and Postnatal Bleeding
passages.text:
Allah Almighty has prescribed several rulings relating to menstruating women and women experiencing their postnatal bleeding, including the following:

- They are exempt from performing the prayers during this period and do not have to make up for the prayers they have missed while in this state after the end of menstrual and postnatal bleeding.
- They are exempt from fasting and are not allowed to fast while in this state, but they must make up for the fasting days they have missed in Ramadaan.
- During this period, a husband must not have intercourse with his wife during her menstrual or postnatal period. He is allowed, however, to satisfy his sexual desire but without having intercourse.
- At the end of the menstrual and postnatal period, when bleeding stops completely, women must take a ritual bath (*ghusl*).

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: What purposes does clothing serve?

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
With your partners, discuss the reasons why some types of clothing are forbidden in Islam.

The Prophet ﷺ forbade men from imitating women and women from imitating men. This prohibition includes the type of clothing and the manner of speech. Islam strictly forbids imitation of the opposite sex, considering it a major sin that invites Allah’s punishment unless one repents and desists from committing it. Islam enjoins men to ensure that their true nature and appearance are distinct from that of women, and vice versa, which clearly testifies to common sense and sound logic.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: Can we turn to fashion trends, customs, traditions or official regulations to determine for us what the appropriate clothing for men and women is?

passages.heading: *Soorat An-Naas* Explained
passages.text:
“Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind”

Say, Messenger, “I seek refuge and protection in Allah, the Lord of all mankind, who alone has power over all things.

“the King of mankind”

The King of all people, who manages all their affairs.

“the God of mankind”

The True God of all people, who alone deserves to be worshipped by them.

“from the evil of the slinking whisperer”

from the harm of Satan who whispers evil suggestions to people when they are heedless of Allah and refrains from doing so when they remember Him.

“who whispers into the hearts of mankind”

who whispers evil suggestions and thoughts into people’s chests and controls their feelings and thoughts.

“from among the jinn and mankind”

from the devils among the jinn and mankind.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: What is the theme that is highlighted in *Soorat Al-Ikhlaas* and *Soorat Al-Kaafiroon*?

passages.heading: Lesson 2
passages.text: ## The Interpretation of Short *Surahs*

passages.heading: Soorat Al-Kawthar (Abundant Good)
passages.text:
*Soorat Al-Kawthar* **Explained**

{{Q:108:1-3}}

“We have bestowed on you abundant good”

We have given you, Messenger, immeasurable, abundant good in this life and the life to come, part of which is River Al-Kawthar in Paradise.

“So pray to your Lord and sacrifice to Him”

Therefore, sincerely pray to your Lord and worship Him alone, and sacrifice to Him, pronouncing Allah’s name alone when slaughtering animals, in gratitude to Him for the honour and good He has bestowed on you.

“He who hates you is the one who is truly cut off”

*Shaani’aka*: The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought.

The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought is the most disgraced and contemptible, whose mention is short-lived and who is cut off from all good.

passages.heading: What are the types of wealth upon which *zakaat* is due?
passages.text:
- **Gold and silver**
- **All types of currency (banknotes and coins)**
- **Farm produce (crops and fruit)**
- **Grazing livestock**

Grazing livestock: This refers to camels, cattle, sheep and goats.

- **Commercial commodities**

Commercial commodities: all properties owned with the aim of investing them in trade. They generally include assets, such as a house, a shop, a car and an animal.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: What do you think would happen if all the rich Muslims paid *zakaat* due on all their wealth?

passages.heading: First
passages.text: to purify one’s heart from over-attachment to wealth and from selfish greed

passages.heading: Second
passages.text: to increase one’s wealth, for *zakaat* does not decrease it, but rather increases it and even blesses it.

passages.heading: Third
passages.text: To help the poor and the needy

passages.heading: What Is *Zakaat*?
passages.text: *Zakaat*: a religious obligation whereby wealthy Muslims give away a certain portion of their wealth to the poor in their midst. It is the third pillar of Islam.

passages.heading: شروط الصلاة:
passages.text:
يشترط لأداء الصلاة عدة شروط، وهي:

- **الطهارة:** وتشمل طهارة البدن والمكان من النجاسات، والطهارة من الحدث بالوضوء أو الغسل.
- **تغطية العورة:** والعورة: ما يجب ستره من البدن أمام الناس. وعورة الرجل التي يجب سترها في الصلاة هي من السرة إلى الركبة، وعورة المرأة التي يجب سترها في الصلاة هي جميع بدنها إلا الوجه والكفّين.
- **استقبال القبلة:** وهي جهة الكعبة المشرفة الموجودة في مكة المكرمة، فيجب على المصلي التوجه إلى جهتها في صلاته.
- **دخول وقت الصلاة:** فلا تصح الصلاة قبل دخول وقتها، ولا يجوز تأخيرها عن وقتها، والأفضل أداؤها في أول وقتها.

passages.heading: المسح على الجوربين:
passages.text: إذا كان المتوضئ لابسًا جوربين في رجلين، فيجوز له الاكتفاء بالمسح عليهما بيديه المبللتين على ظاهر القدمين، ولا حاجة لنزعهما وغسل القدمين، ويشترط لذلك ثلاثة شروط:

passages.heading: معنى السورة:
أن تكون المرأة هي زوجته
passages.text: يجوز لهما ما لا يجوز لغيرهما من النظر والاستماع، وقد سمّى الله الزوج لباساً للزوجة والزوجة لباساً للزوج، كصورة رائعة من الاتصال النفسي والعاطفي والجسدي بينهما

passages.heading: ما حكم أكل الحيوانات البحرية ؟
passages.text:
الحيوانات المائية التي لا تعيش إلا في الماء يجوز أكل ميتتها، كالأسماك والربيان وغير ذلك، سواء كانت تعيش في البحار أو الأنهار أو البحيرات.

يجوز صيد الحيوانات البرية غير المفترسة وأكلها، بشرط ذكر اسم الله أثناء صيدها، وذبحها إذا وجدها حيةً.

passages.heading: الثاني
passages.text: أن يغطي الجورب القدم مع الكعبين.

passages.heading: ناقش
passages.text:
استعرض مع زملائك بعض التحديات التي تواجه المسلم لتمنعه من أداء الصلاة في وقتها، وكيف يتم تجاوز هذه التحديات؟

{{Q:62:9}} (الجمعة: 9).

اذكر عبادتين من العبادات الخاصة بيوم الجمعة.

ما أثر الصلوات الخمس على حياة المسلم اليومية؟

من خلال زيارتك لهذا الموقع: islamicfiqh.net/en تحدث عن حكم تارك الصلاة في الإسلام

العورة التي يجب على الرجل سترها في الصلاة:
أ) جميع البدن باستثناء الوجه واليدين والقدمين.
ب) من السرة إلى الركبة.
ج) من الكتف إلى الركبة.

الجهة التي يجب على المصلي التوجه لها هي:
أ) جهة الشمال.
ب) جهة الغرب.
ج) جهة الكعبة.

يقول المصلي في سجوده:
أ) سبحان ربي العظيم.
ب) سبحان ربي الأعلى.
ج) رب اغفر لي.

passages.heading: ناقش
passages.text: استعرض بعض الحِكَم المستخلصة من إسقاط بعض التكاليف الشرعية عن المرأة؟

يجب على المرأة المسلمة أن تستر جميع بدنها عن:
- أ) النساء الأخريات.
- ب) الرجال الأجانب.
- ج) والد الزوج.

يجب على الحائض والنفساء إذا طهرت أن تقضي:
- أ) الصلاة.
- ب) الصوم.
- ج) جميع ما سبق.

passages.heading: الأول
passages.text: أن يكون لبس الجوربين على طهارة.

passages.heading: الثالث
passages.text:
أن لا تزيد مدة المسح عليهما عن (٢٤ ساعة) للمقيم، أو (٧٢ ساعة) للمسافر.

تبدأ مدة المسح على الجوارب من وقت أول مسحٍ عليها.

passages.heading: المسح على الجوربين:
passages.text: إذا كان المتوضئ لابسًا جوربين في رجلين، فيجوز له الاكتفاء بالمسح عليهما بيديه المبللتين على ظاهر القدمين، ولا حاجة لنزعهما وغسل القدمين، ويشترط لذلك ثلاثة شروط:

passages.heading: الأول
passages.text: أن يكون لبس الجوربين على طهارة.

passages.heading: الثاني
passages.text: أن يغطي الجورب القدم مع الكعبين.

passages.heading: متى يجب على أن أعيد الوضوء؟
passages.text: إذا توضأ المسلم فالأصل بقاء وضوئه حتى يحصل معه ما يوجب الوضوء، مما سبق ذكره.

passages.heading: متى يجب الغسل؟
passages.text: يجب الغسل على المسلم في ثلاثة أحوال:

passages.heading: تمهيد
passages.text: يأخذ الوضوء أهميته في الإسلام بسبب ارتباطه الوثيق بشعيرة الصلاة التي تعد أعظم شعائر المسلم، ومن هنا كان على المسلم الحرص على تعلمه بالطريقة الصحيحة، وفي هذا الدرس سنتعرف على معنى الوضوء، والأسباب التي تُوجبه، ونواقضه، وكيفيته الصحيحة.

passages.heading: كيف نتوضأ؟
passages.text:
إذا أراد المسلم أن يتوضأ فعليه القيام بالخطوات الآتية:

1. يقول: «بسم الله».
2. يغسل كفيّه بالماء مبتدئًا باليمنى.
3. ينظف فمه بإدخال الماء فيه، ثم يحركه، ثم يخرجه.
4. ينظف أنفه بإدخال الماء فيه مع الاستنشاق، ثم يخرجه مع نفخ الهواء من أنفه.
5. يغسل وجه كاملًا، وحدوده طولًا من منابت الشعر في أعلى الجبهة إلى أسفل الذقن، مع شعر اللحية إن وجدت، وحدوده عرضًا من الأذن إلى الأذن.
6. يغسل يديه من أطراف الأصابع إلى مفصل المرفق، مبتدئًا بيده اليمنى.
7. يبلل يديه بالماء، ثم يمسح بهما رأسه، مبتدئًا بمقدمة الرأس إلى القفا، ثم يعيد يديه إلى الأمام.
8. يمسح أذنيه بأصبعيه السبابتين داخل الأذنين، ويمسح خلف الأذنين بالإبهامين.
9. يغسل قدميه إلى الكعبين، وهما العظمان البارزان في مفصل القدم، مبتدئًا برجله اليمنى.

passages.heading: What is the Islamic Ruling on Seafood Consumption?
passages.text:
It is permissible to eat dead aquatic animals that can live only in water, such as fish and prawns, whether they live in the sea, rivers or lakes.

It is permissible to hunt wild, nonpredatory animals and consume their flesh provided that the name of Allah is mentioned before the hunting weapon is discharged, and the hunted game must be slaughtered if found still alive.

passages.heading: Its miraculous nature
passages.text: The Arab unbelievers rejected the Qur’an, so Allah challenged them to produce the like of it, or one soorah like it, or even ten verses, but they were unable to do so.

passages.heading: The Meaning of Worship
passages.text: By worship is meant everything that Allah has enjoined on us for us to draw closer to Him. It comprises all words and deeds that Allah loves, whether they are outward like the physical acts of worship, such as the prayer and pilgrimage, or inward, like the acts of worship involving the heart, such as love of Allah, fearing His punishment and hoping for His mercy. A person can transform everyday habits into acts of worship simply by having a good intention. If, for instance, he eats, drinks and sleeps with the intention of gaining enough strength to worship Allah better, he will certainly be rewarded for doing so

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
A man's *'awrah* that must be covered extends from the navel to the knees. A woman must cover herself entirely in the presence of men not related to her; as for men to whom she is related and is forbidden to marry, such as her father, son and brother, she may appear before them as she would normally do in front of other women, showing such parts of her body as the face, hair, the neck and feet.

- Clothing that reveals the *'awrah* and does not conceal it
- Clothing that involves dressing like or imitating the opposite sex, such as when men dress like women and vice versa.
- Clothing that is worn with an air of pride and conceit
- Extravagant clothing
- Men are particularly forbidden to wear silk clothing or adorn themselves with gold or silver jewellery.
- Clothing that involves imitation of the dress traditionally worn by non-Muslims and specific to a certain religion, such as the type of clothing worn by monks and priests

passages.heading: The Manner of Performing the Full Ritual Bath (*Ghusl*)
passages.text:
If a Muslim wants to perform *ghusl*, he must do the following:

1. He intends in his heart to perform *ghusl* and washes out his private parts with water.
2. He performs *wudoo’* like the one he performs before the prayer.
3. He washes his entire body with water.

passages.heading: Islamic Rulings Pertaining to Meat Served in Restaurants and Shops
passages.text:
1. The meat of animals that are slaughtered by other than a Muslim or a member of the People of the Book (a Christian or a Jew), such as a Buddhist, or a Hindu is strictly forbidden. This includes meat served in restaurants and shops in countries where Muslims or People of the Book constitute a minority.
2. The meat of animals killed by a Muslim or a member of the People of the Book is lawful based on textual evidence to this effect in the Qur’an.
3. The meat of animals that are not killed according to Islamic law, such as by electrocution and drowning, is strictly forbidden.
4. The general rule is that it is permissible to consume the flesh of animals slaughtered by People of the Book as well as meat of animals generally found in their restaurants and shops, making sure, however, to invoke Allah’s name at the time of eating (that is, by saying *Bismillaah*), but it is better for Muslims to eat only meat that has been proven to be lawful (*halaal*).

passages.heading: The General Islamic Rule Regarding Food and drink
passages.text: The general Islamic rule is that everything is presumed permissible unless proven otherwise in the Qur’an or the Prophet’s *Sunnah*. The Almighty says, {{Q:2:168}} *(Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:168)*.

passages.heading: Muslim Women’s Modest Style of Dress (*Hijaab*)
passages.text:
Allah enjoins women to wear the *hijaab* because women enjoy natural beauty and attraction that could easily tempt men into sinful acts, more than the other way round. Women are to cover their entire bodies when in the presence of men who are not related to them, and they may choose any design or colour they like for their *hijaab* as long as the following four conditions are met:

| First Condition | Second Condition | Third condition | Fourth Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| It must appropriately cover the parts of the body that must be covered in public. | It must hang loose and must not fit very closely to the body so that the shape of the body is not revealed. | It must not allow the wearer’s body to be seen through its fabric. | It must not be a type of clothing that is generally considered attractive. |

passages.heading: What Are the Conditions for Islamic Slaughter?
passages.text:
Islamic slaughter is one that satisfies the following conditions:

1. The person undertaking the slaughtering process must be Muslim, Jew or Christian who has reached the age of discretion and carries out this act for the intended purpose.
2. The tool used for slaughter must be suitable for the intended purpose, causes blood to flow and sharp, such as a knife. It is forbidden to use anything that may kill the animal due to its heavy weight, hit its head to death or render it unconscious by resorting to electric stunning, for instance.
3. The name of Allah must be pronounced by saying *Bismillaah* (in the name of Allah) at the time of slaughtering the animal.
4. Cutting what must be cut in the Islamic slaughter, namely, the oesophagus, the throat, and the two jugular veins, or just three of these four.

passages.text:
With your partners, browse some Internet websites that help you find lawful (*halaal*) foods in your country.

The Islamic rulings on the meat of animals that are sold in shops and restaurants vary according to the religion of the person who slaughtered such animals.

passages.heading: Its language
passages.text: Allah Almighty revealed it in Arabic.

passages.heading: Its source
passages.text: Allah Almighty revealed it to His Messenger ﷺ through Gabriel ؑ.

passages.heading: Its revelation
passages.text: Allah Almighty revealed it piecemeal in 23 years in Makkah and Madeenah.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: In his life, a Muslim performs a number of acts of worship whereby he draws closer to his Creator, Glory is to Him. We do such acts to glorify Allah Almighty and submit to Him alone. The more a Muslim’s heart glorifies Allah, Exalted be He, the greater the effect of doing so is on his worship. A true Muslim dedicates all life, including the time he spends at work, sleeping and having fun, to Allah Almighty, bearing in mind the verse: {{Q:6:162-163}} (Soorat Al-An’aam, 6:162-163) In this lesson, we are going to learn about the meaning of worship, its types, the conditions that must be met for it to be accepted, and its levels.

passages.heading: Types of Acts of Worship
passages.text:
Acts of worship fall into different categories:

| Acts of worship involving the heart | A Muslim performs these with his heart. Examples include love, fear, hope and *khushoo’*. |
| --- | --- |
| Physical acts of worship | A Muslim performs these physically. Examples include the prayer, *zakaat* and pilgrimage. |
| Acts that are abandoned in obedience to Allah | A Muslim draws closer to his Lord by abandoning the acts He has forbidden him, such as drinking alcohol and committing adultery, or by refraining from certain permissible acts at specific times, such as abstaining from food and drink while fasting. |

> *Ar-Rajaa’*(Hope): This refers to rejoicing in Allah’s grace and hoping for His benevolence, while at the same time ensuring proper reliance on Allah by doing good deeds to the best of one’s ability.
> 
> *Al-khushoo’* is a state of utter humility and calmness and deep concentration into which one gets while performing an act of worship, such as the prayer, bringing about outward composure and tranquillity.

passages.heading: Conditions for Acts of Worship to Be Accepted
passages.text:
For an act of worship to be accepted, two conditions must be fulfilled:

The first condition: It has to be done sincerely for the sake of Allah to draw closer to alone, without showing off.

The second condition: It has to be done in the manner Allah has enjoined it and exactly as it was performed by the Prophet ﷺ.

> *Aririyyaa’* (showing off) is the act of doing an act of worship only to be seen and praised by people for doing it.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: What will a person who shows off his acts of worship lose by not intending to do them for the sake of Allah?

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: Muslims consider food and drink to be among the countless blessings of Allah for which they must show gratitude. Part of showing gratitude for them lies in gaining strength from them to perform the acts of worship properly. In this lesson, we are going to learn about a set of rulings and etiquette related to food and drink, as well as forbidden foods that Muslims must avoid.

passages.heading: Allah Almighty has forbidden different types of food and drink, including the following:
passages.text:
- Alcohol, because it clouds the mind; indeed, preserving the mind is one of the objectives of Islamic law (*Sharee’ah*).
- Drugs, because they destroy the mind and body.
- Animals that die without having been slaughtered, or those that are slaughtered but the name of Allah (i.e., saying *Bismillaah* (in the name of Allah) was not mentioned at the time of slaughter.
- Pork—and indeed any of the pig’s body parts and by-products—because it is impure and thus forbidden for human consumption.
- Predatory animals, such as lions, tigers, hawks and eagles.
- Any animals that are sacrificed to false deities, such as idols.

The objectives of *Sharee’ah*: This is one of Islamic sciences by which Islamic laws are determined, such as the reason why Allah has laid down such-and-such a rule.

passages.heading: Второе. Смысл свидетельства «Мухаммад — Посланник Аллаха»
passages.text: Слова «Я свидетельствую, что Мухаммад — Посланник Аллаха» означают: «Я твердо верую, что Мухаммад ﷺ — Посланник Аллаха, и что он последний пророк, после которого больше не будет пророков, и что его послание адресовано всем людям. Всевышний Аллах сказал: {{Q:25:1}} (сура «аль-Фуркан», аят 1).

passages.heading: Запрещенные виды имущественных отношений
passages.text:
Всевышний Аллах запретил некоторые виды имущественных отношений:

- Присвоение чужого имущества без права, например, обманом или силой.
- Принуждение одного из участников к сделке, которую он не хочет заключать.
- Торговля товарами, вредными для здоровья человека, такими как алкоголь, наркотики, табак и другие.
- Ростовщичество, то есть ссуда денег при условии их возврата с добавлением некоторого процента от заемных денег, например, ты должен отдать на 5% больше денег, чем занимал.
- Продажа неизвестного товара, например, ящика, содержимое которого неизвестно.
- Азартные игры и пари, в которых победитель забирает деньги проигравшего.

passages.heading: Плоды имана
passages.text:
* Познание Всевышнего Аллаха. Верующий познаёт своего Господа и это увеличивает его привязанность к Нему, и он узнаёт Его имена, качества и деяния.
* Возвеличивание Аллаха. Чем больше верующий познаёт своего Господа, тем больше он возвеличивает, почитает и любит Его, тем сильнее он надеется на Него, боится Его и проявляет смиренность перед Ним.
* Осознание того, насколько милостив Аллах к Своим рабам, ведь Он отправил к ним посланников и ниспослал им писания, чтобы люди пришли к истинной религии.
* Любовь к ангелам, ведь они поклоняются и повинуются Аллаху.
* Любовь к посланникам, ведь Всевышний Аллах избрал их для донесения Своего послания людям.
* Усердие в поклонении. Чем сильнее становится иман, тем больше и лучше человек поклоняется Аллаху.
* Благая жизнь. Верующий доволен тем уделом, которым Аллах наделил его, он знает, что бедствия, которые постигают его в этом мире, возвышают его степень и стирают его грехи, и он надеется обрести те милости, которые Аллах уготовил для верующих в жизни вечной.
* Стойкость перед обольщениями этого мира. Жизнь в этом мире временна, она является лишь путем, ведущим к вечной жизни в следующем мире.
* Разоблачение суеверий. Иман разоблачает суеверия, выявляя их несостоятельность.
* Вхождение в Рай. Рай — это обитель вечного, непрерывного наслаждения. Всевышний Аллах создал его для Своих верующих рабов.

passages.heading: Достоинство благонравия
passages.text:
- Пророк ﷺ сообщил, что больше всего людей введет в Рай богобоязненность и благонравие.
- Пророк ﷺ сообщил, что в Судный день благонравие станет самым тяжелым из благих дел на весах человека.
- Пророк ﷺ сообщил, что в Судный день ближе всех к нему окажутся самые благонравные люди.

> Весы человека. В Судный день будут установлены особые Весы, на которых будут взвешены благие и греховные деяния человека. Тот, чьи благие деяния перевесят его грехи, войдет в Рай; а тот, чьи грехи перевесят благие деяния, войдет в Огонь.

passages.heading: Урок второй
passages.text: «Путем тех, кого Ты облагодетельствовал, не тех, которые под гневом, и не заблудших». Это путь тех, кого Ты облагодетельствовал: пророков, их приверженцев и тех, кто идут по их стопам. Они следуют прямым путем. О Аллах, не делай нас людьми, следующими путем тех, на кого Ты разгневан за то, что они, зная истину, не стали поступать согласно ей, и заблудших невежд, отклонившихся от правильного пути.

passages.heading: (Неверующие)
passages.text:
{{Q:?}}

Смысл суры:

*«Скажи: “О неверующие!”»* Скажи, о Посланник, тем, которые не веруют в Аллаха и Его Посланника: «О неверующие в Аллаха!»

*«Я не поклоняюсь тому, чему поклоняетесь вы»* Я не поклоняюсь идолам и ложным божествам, которым вы поклоняетесь.

*«И вы не поклоняетесь Тому, Кому поклоняюсь я»* А вы не поклоняетесь Единому Богу — Аллаху, Господу миров, Единственному достойному поклонения.

*«Я не буду поклоняться тому, чему поклоняетесь вы».* Я не буду поклоняться идолам и ложным божествам, которым вы поклоняетесь.

*«И вы не будете поклоняться Тому, Кому поклоняюсь я».* И вы не станете поклоняться Единому Богу — Аллаху, Господу миров, Единственному достойному поклонения.

*«У вас — ваша религия, а у меня — моя».* Вам — ваша религия, в приверженности которой вы упорствуете, а мне — моя религия, и я не желаю иной.

> Неверующий (кяфир) — тот, кто не засвидетельствовал Единственность Аллаха и не последовал посланию Его Посланника Мухаммада ﷺ.

passages.heading: Введение
passages.text: Мусульманин в течение всей своей жизни совершает те или иные виды поклонения, посредством которых он приближается к своему Творцу, Свят Он и Возвышен. Все эти обряды поклонения предназначены для прославления Аллаха и подчинения Ему и никому другому. Чем больше сердце мусульманина прославляет Всевышнего Аллаха, тем заметнее влияние этого на его поклонение. Истинный мусульманин — это тот, кто всю свою жизнь, включая работу, сон и развлечения, посвящает Одному лишь Всевышнему Аллаху, претворяя в жизнь Его слова: «Скажи: “Моя молитва, и мое жертвоприношение [, и мое поклонение], и моя жизнь, и моя смерть посвящены Аллаху, Господу миров. Нет у Него сотоварищей. Это мне велено, и я — первый из покорившихся”» (сура «аль-Ан'ам», аяты 162–163). На этом уроке мы узнаем о значении поклонения, его видах, условиях его принятия и его степенях.

passages.heading: Смысл суры:
passages.text:
«Скажи: “Он — Аллах — Един”» Скажи, о Посланник, тем, кто попросил тебя описать своего Господа: «Он — Аллах, Единственный обладающий Божественностью и Господством, нет божества, кроме Него».

«Аллах самодостаточен» Он — Аллах, который совершенен в качествах славы и величия, к Которому творения обращаются за удовлетворением своих нужд и желаний.

«Он не родил и не был рожден» У него нет ни детей, ни родителей, ни супруги.

«…и нет никого, равного Ему» Среди Его творений нет никого, такого же, как Он, или хотя бы подобного Ему, — ни в Его именах, ни в Его качествах, ни в Его действиях.

passages.heading: Урок третий
passages.text:
## Как принять Ислам?

Суть Ислама, являющегося религией всех пророков, — это поклонение Одному лишь Аллаху и неверие во все, чему поклоняются помимо Него. Всевышний Аллах сказал: {{Q:21:25}} (сура «аль-Анбия», аят 25).

Поэтому ни при каких обстоятельствах не дозволено верить в божественность чего-либо или кого-либо, кроме Всевышнего Аллаха, и искать приближения к кому-либо, кроме Всевышнего Аллаха, посредством какого бы то ни было вида поклонения.

passages.heading: Требования двух свидетельств
passages.text:
Недостаточно просто произнести эти свидетельства, необходимо знать их значение и действовать согласно тому, что они требуют. Свидетельство «Нет божества, кроме Аллаха» требует неверия во всё, чему поклоняются, кроме Всевышнего Аллаха, и веры в Аллаха как Единственного Господа и Бога, достойного поклонения, вместе с искренностью в поклонении Ему. Всевышний Аллах сказал: {{Q:2:256}} (сура «аль-Бакара», аят 256).

А свидетельство «Мухаммад — Посланник Аллаха» требует веры в то, что сообщил нам Пророк ﷺ; повиновения ему в том, что он ﷺ повелел или запретил нам; и поклонения Аллаху только таким образом, как он ﷺ научил нас.

passages.heading: Обсуждение
passages.text:
Почему свидетельство «Нет божества, кроме Аллаха» требует неверия во все, чему поклоняются помимо Аллаха?

Перечислите причины, по которым некоторые люди создают себе разных божеств и призывают людей поклоняться им.

Один из логических аргументов, которые пророк Аллаха Ибрахим, мир ему, привел своему народу, имел форму вопроса: {{Q:37:95}} (сура «ас-Саффат», аят 95).

passages.heading: Урок третий
passages.text: ## Имущественные отношения

passages.heading: Причины запрета тех или иных видов имущественных отношений
passages.text:
Основные причины запрета некоторых видов имущественных отношений:

1. несправедливость
2. ростовщичество
3. неопределенность или спекуляция

passages.heading: Обсуждение
passages.text: Различные виды имущественных отношений занимают большое место в жизни каждого мусульманина. Как ему разобраться, какие имущественные сделки дозволены, а какие запрещены?

passages.heading: Плоды имана
passages.text:
У имана много плодов, и мы приведем здесь лишь некоторые из них:

* Умиротворение души. Иман умиротворяет душу человека, вселяет в нее довольство Аллахом и Его предопределением и избавляет ее от страха перед кем-либо или чем-либо, помимо Аллаха.

> Аль-Кадар (судьба) — это изначальное предопределение Всевышним Аллахом всех вещей и Его знание, что они произойдут в известное Ему время определенным образом.

passages.heading: Мои заметки
passages.text: Запишите, какие плоды имана вы увидели после принятия Ислама.

passages.heading: Сура «ан-Нас» (Люди)
passages.text:
{{Q:114:1-6}}

**Смысл суры:**

_«Скажи: “Я ищу защиты у Господа людей”»._ Скажи, о Посланник: «Я прошу защиты у Господа людей, ибо только Он мощен над всякой вещью».

_«Царя людей»_ Властелина всех людей, распоряжающегося всеми их делами и не нуждающегося ни в ком из них.

_«Бога людей»_ Бога всех людей, кроме Которого никто не достоин поклонения.

_«…от зла искусителя, отбегающего [при поминании Аллаха]»_ От зла, причиняемого шайтаном, который наущает людей, когда они беспечны, и скрывается при поминании Аллаха.

_«…который нашептывает в сердца людей»_ Который внушает зло и сомнения людским сердцам.

_«…от джиннов и людей»._ От шайтанов из числа джиннов и людей.

passages.heading: Обсуждение
passages.text: Какова основная тема сур «аль-Ихляс» и «аль-Кяфирун»?

passages.heading: Урок второй
passages.text: ## Толкование коротких сур

passages.heading: Сура «аль-Кяусар»
passages.text:
**Смысл суры:**

«Поистине, Мы даровали тебе Кяусар» Поистине, Мы даровали тебе, о Пророк, множество благ в этом мире и мире вечном, в том числе и реку Кяусар в Раю.

«Потому молись своему Господу и закалывай [жертву]» Посвяти свою молитву целиком своему Господу, и совершай заклание жертвенного животного только ради Него и с Его Именем.

«Поистине, твой ненавистник сам лишен всякого блага» Поистине, тот, кто ненавидит тебя и принесенное тобой верное руководство и свет, сам является ничтожным и презренным, и он будет лишен всякого блага.

Твой ненавистник — тот, кто ненавидит тебя и истинную религию, которую ты принес.

passages.heading: Обсуждение
passages.text: Что помогает запомнить суру «аль-Фатиха»?

passages.heading: Смысл суры:
passages.text:
«Скажи: “Я ищу защиты у Господа рассвета”» Скажи, о Посланник: «Я прошу защиты у Аллаха — Господа рассвета, то есть начала утра».

«От зла того, что Он сотворил» От зла всех творений и вреда, причиняемого ими, видимого нам и невидимого.

«И от зла мрака, когда он наступает» От зла наступающей ночи с ее мраком и от дурных и вредных вещей, таящихся под ее покровом.

Аль-фаляк — начало утра.

Аль-гасак — непроглядный мрак ночи.

passages.heading: Урок второй
passages.text:
### Толкование коротких сур

_«От зла [колдуний], поплевывающих на узлы»_ От зла колдуний, дующих на узлы, завязанные для колдовских деяний.

_«От зла завистника, когда он завидует»_ От зла завистника, желающего, чтобы объект его зависти лишился своих благ и его постигла беда.

passages.heading: What Are the Conditions for Islamic Slaughter?
passages.text:
Islamic slaughter is one that satisfies the following conditions:

1. The person undertaking the slaughtering process must be Muslim, Jew or Christian who has reached the age of discretion and carries out this act for the intended purpose.
2. The tool used for slaughter must be suitable for the intended purpose, causes blood to flow and sharp, such as a knife. It is forbidden to use anything that may kill the animal due to its heavy weight, hit its head to death or render it unconscious by resorting to electric stunning, for instance.
3. The name of Allah must be pronounced by saying *Bismillaah* (in the name of Allah) at the time of slaughtering the animal.
4. Cutting what must be cut in the Islamic slaughter, namely, the oesophagus, the throat, and the two jugular veins, or just three of these four.

passages.heading: Wiping over the Socks
passages.text: If a person wants to perform *wudoo’* while he has his socks on, he is allowed to just wipe over the top of them with wet hands, and there is no need to take them off and wash the feet. Three conditions are required for this:

passages.heading: What shall I do if I find water after having performed *tayammum*?
passages.text: If a Muslim finds water or can use it, his purity becomes invalid, in which case he must perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl*.

passages.heading: What is the Islamic Ruling on Seafood Consumption?
passages.text:
It is permissible to eat dead aquatic animals that can live only in water, such as fish and prawns, whether they live in the sea, rivers or lakes.

It is permissible to hunt wild, nonpredatory animals and consume their flesh provided that the name of Allah is mentioned before the hunting weapon is discharged, and the hunted game must be slaughtered if found still alive.

passages.heading: *Soorat Al-Kaafiroon* Explained
passages.text:
{{Q:109:1-6}}

“Say: Unbelievers!”

Say, Messenger, to those who disbelieve in Allah and His Messenger: You unbelievers.

“I do not worship what you worship”

I do not worship the false gods, such as idols, that you worship.

“nor do you worship what I worship”

nor do you worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

“I will never worship what you worship”

I will never worship the false gods that you worship.

“nor will you ever worship what I worship”

nor will you ever worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

Al-kaafir: The person who does not proclaim pure monotheism and does not follow the divine message Prophet Muhammad ﷺ has brought.

“You have your religion, and I have my religion”

You have your religion to which you adhere, and I have my religion to which I adhere.

passages.heading: Soorat Al-Falaq Explained
passages.text:
“Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak” Say, Messenger: I seek refuge and protection in Allah, the Lord of the daybreak.

“from the evil of what He has created”

from the evil of everything He has created, visible and invisible.

“and from the evil of the night when it spreads its darkness”

and from the evil of the night when it comes and grows dark, and of whatever evil and harm that may happen in it.

Al-ghasaq: the intense darkness of the night

Al-falaq: the daybreak

passages.heading: Some of the Ultimate Objectives and Benefits of Fasting
passages.text:
- To attain true piety by increasing acts of worship and avoiding sins as much as possible.
- To experience the pangs of hunger from which the poor and needy often suffer.
- To train oneself to bring one’s whims and desires under control.

Allah has enjoined fasting on Muslims, just as He prescribed it on the other nations before them:
{{Q:2:183}} (Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:183).

passages.heading: The Types of People Who Are Exempt from Fasting
passages.text:
Allah Almighty has permitted several types of people to break their fast during the day in Ramadaan. They are:

1. Sick people whose medical condition is bound to be further worsened by fasting.
2. The elderly who are unable to fast.
3. Travellers, while moving from one place to another.
4. Menstruating women and women experiencing postnatal bleeding.
5. Pregnant and nursing mothers if they fear it would be dangerous for them or for their babies if they fast.

passages.heading: Allah Almighty has forbidden different types of food and drink, including the following:
passages.text:
- Alcohol, because it clouds the mind; indeed, preserving the mind is one of the objectives of Islamic law (*Sharee’ah*).
- Drugs, because they destroy the mind and body.
- Animals that die without having been slaughtered, or those that are slaughtered but the name of Allah (i.e., saying *Bismillaah* (in the name of Allah) was not mentioned at the time of slaughter.
- Pork—and indeed any of the pig’s body parts and by-products—because it is impure and thus forbidden for human consumption.
- Predatory animals, such as lions, tigers, hawks and eagles.
- Any animals that are sacrificed to false deities, such as idols.

The objectives of *Sharee’ah*: This is one of Islamic sciences by which Islamic laws are determined, such as the reason why Allah has laid down such-and-such a rule.

passages.heading: Islamic Rulings Pertaining to Meat Served in Restaurants and Shops
passages.text:
1. The meat of animals that are slaughtered by other than a Muslim or a member of the People of the Book (a Christian or a Jew), such as a Buddhist, or a Hindu is strictly forbidden. This includes meat served in restaurants and shops in countries where Muslims or People of the Book constitute a minority.
2. The meat of animals killed by a Muslim or a member of the People of the Book is lawful based on textual evidence to this effect in the Qur’an.
3. The meat of animals that are not killed according to Islamic law, such as by electrocution and drowning, is strictly forbidden.
4. The general rule is that it is permissible to consume the flesh of animals slaughtered by People of the Book as well as meat of animals generally found in their restaurants and shops, making sure, however, to invoke Allah’s name at the time of eating (that is, by saying *Bismillaah*), but it is better for Muslims to eat only meat that has been proven to be lawful (*halaal*).

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text:
With your partners, browse some Internet websites that help you find lawful (*halaal*) foods in your country.

The Islamic rulings on the meat of animals that are sold in shops and restaurants vary according to the religion of the person who slaughtered such animals.

passages.heading: First
passages.text: He must be in a state of purity before putting them on.

passages.heading: Second
passages.text: The socks must cover the feet along with the ankles.

passages.heading: Third
passages.text:
The period of wiping over them must not exceed 24 hours for a resident and 72 hours for a traveller.

The period of wiping over the socks begins from the first time one wipes over them.

passages.heading: *Tayammum* (Dry Ablution)
passages.text:
If a person who wants to perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl* is unable to do so due to illness, or when water is not readily available, or for any other legitimate reason, he may resort to dry ablution (*tayammum*) instead.

The Manner of Performing *Tayammum*: (1) Intend in his heart to perform *tayammum* and strike both hands slightly on pure earth once, (2) wipe the face with them, (3) wipe the back of the right hand with the palm of the left, and then the back of the left hand with the palm of the right hand.

passages.heading: ما حكم أكل الحيوانات البحرية ؟
passages.text:
الحيوانات المائية التي لا تعيش إلا في الماء يجوز أكل ميتتها، كالأسماك والربيان وغير ذلك، سواء كانت تعيش في البحار أو الأنهار أو البحيرات.

يجوز صيد الحيوانات البرية غير المفترسة وأكلها، بشرط ذكر اسم الله أثناء صيدها، وذبحها إذا وجدها حيةً.

passages.heading: أحكام الذبائح في المطاعم والمحلات:
passages.text:
1. ما ذبحه غير المسلم والكتابي كالبوذيين والهندوس واللادينيين فهذا محرم، ويدخل فيه ما يوجد في مطاعم ومحلات البلاد التي غالب أهلها من غير المسلمين وأهل الكتاب.
2. ما ذبحه المسلم أو الكتابي بالطريقة الشرعية فهذا جائز بنص القرآن.
3. ما ذبحه المسلم أو الكتابي بطريقة غير شرعية كالصعق والإغراق فهذا محرم.
4. الأصل جواز ذبيحة الكتابي وما يوجد في مطاعمهم ومحلاتهم، وإن لم نتحقق من طريقة ذبحها، مع الحرص على التسمية عند الأكل. والأولى للمسلم ألا يأكل إلا ما تحقق من كونه من لحوم الحلال المباحة.

passages.heading: نواقض الوضوء:
passages.text:
ينتقض الوضوء بأحد أربعة أمور:
- خروج الريح أو البول أو الغائط أو المني أو الرطوبة التي تصاحب ثوران الشهوة.
- زوال العقل بنوم أو سُكْر.
- لمس الفرج بشهوة.
- أكل لحم الجمل.

passages.heading: أن تكون المرأة هي زوجته
passages.text: يجوز لهما ما لا يجوز لغيرهما من النظر والاستماع، وقد سمّى الله الزوج لباساً للزوجة والزوجة لباساً للزوج، كصورة رائعة من الاتصال النفسي والعاطفي والجسدي بينهما

passages.heading: ماذا أفعل إذا وجدت الماء بعد أن تيممت؟
passages.text: إذا وجد المسلم الماء أو قدر على استعماله انتقضت طهارته ووجب عليه الوضوء أو الغسل بعد ذلك .

وجوهر دين الإسلام الذي هو دين الأنبياء جميعًا: عبادة الله وحده، والكفر بكل ما يعبد من دونه.

قال الله تعالى: {{Q:21:25}} (الأنبياء: ٢٥).

فلا يجوز بأي حال من الأحوال اعتقاد ألوهية أي شيء سوى الله تعالى، ولا يجوز التقرب إلى غير الله تعالى بأي نوعٍ من العبادات.

passages.heading: معنى السورة:
من يباح لهم الفطر في رمضان؟
passages.text:
أباح الله عز وجل الفطر في نهار رمضان لعدة أصنافٍ من الناس، وهم:

1. المريض الذي يتضرر من الصوم.
2. الكبير في السن الذي يعجز عن الصوم.
3. المسافر أثناء سفره.
4. الحائض والنفساء.
5. الحامل والمرضع إذا خافتا على نفسيهما أو على ولدهما.

passages.heading: ما هي شروط الذكاة الشرعية ؟
passages.text:
الذكاة الشرعية هي الذبح أو النحر المستوفي للشروط التالية:

1. أن يكون الذابح مسلماً أو يهودياً أو نصرانياً يميز ويقصد الذكاة.
2. أن تكون الآلة صالحة للذبح وتُجري الدم وتقطع بحدها كالسكين، ويحرم استخدام ما يقتلها بثقله واصطدامه برأس الحيوان، أو بحرقه كالصعق الكهربائي.
3. أن يذكر اسم الله فيقول: (بسم الله) عند تحريك يده للذبح.
4. قطع ما يجب قطعه في الذكاة، وهو: المريء، والحلقوم، والودجان وهما العرقان الكبيران في الرقبة، أو قطع ثلاثة من هذه الأربعة.

passages.heading: ناقش
passages.text:
استعرض مع زملائك بعض المواقع التي تعينك على الحصول على الأطعمة المباحة في بلدك.

تختلف أحكام الذبائح التي تباع في المحلات والمطاعم بحسب ديانة من باشر ذبحها.

passages.heading: ناقش
passages.text: عدد بعض الوسائل المعينة على تعلم الوضوء وتطبيقه بشكل صحيح؟

passages.heading: متى يجب على أن أعيد الوضوء؟
passages.text: إذا توضأ المسلم فالأصل بقاء وضوئه حتى يحصل معه ما يوجب الوضوء، مما سبق ذكره.

passages.heading: My Notes
passages.text: Write down some of the benefits of faith that you have enjoyed after embracing Islam.

passages.heading: What Is *Zakaat*?
passages.text: *Zakaat*: a religious obligation whereby wealthy Muslims give away a certain portion of their wealth to the poor in their midst. It is the third pillar of Islam.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: Since ancient times, people on this earth have led different lives with varying living standards. Some are very well-to-do; others are destitute and can barely find anything to eat. This is one of Allah’s ways in this universe. Islam enjoins the wealthy to pay a certain percentage of their wealth to the poor to relieve them of the burden of poverty and urges Muslims to spend more of what they are required to spend, promising them great rewards for doing so both in this life and after death. It also urges them to give charity to the needy at all times and on every occasion and encourages them to feed the hungry and clothe the naked in order for the Muslim community to become close-knit, just as Allah Almighty wants it to be. In this lesson, we are going to learn about the Islamic ruling on *zakaat*, the manner of paying it and the types of wealth upon which it is due.

5. He resumes the standing position, raising his hands up to the level of the shoulders or the ears, saying: Sami’allaahu li man hamidah “Allah hears those who praise Him.” Then he says while standing: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd “Our Lord, to You is due all praise.”

6. He says, Allaahu akbar “Allah is the Greatest” and prostrates himself, with the toes of both feet, the knees, the palms of the hands and the forehead and the nose touching the floor. He says three times while in this position, “Glory be to my Lord, Most High.”

passages.heading: What shall I do if I find water after having performed *tayammum*?
passages.text: If a Muslim finds water or can use it, his purity becomes invalid, in which case he must perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl*.

passages.heading: Shirk
passages.text:
3. **Belief in the divinely revealed books:** A Muslim believes that Allah sent down divine books to His Messengers to guide people to the truth and teach them their religion. These include the Torah (*At-Tawraah*) which He revealed to Moses (Moosaa) son of ‘Imraan, the Zaboor which He revealed to David (Daawood), the Gospel (*Al-Injeel*) which He revealed to Jesus (‘Eesaa) son of Mary and the Qur’an which He revealed to Muhammad, peace be upon them all. He also believes that the Qur’an is the last of them and that it has final authority over them all.
4. **Belief in the prophets:** A Muslim believes that Allah Almighty sent messengers to their people and supported them with miracles to prove their truthfulness. He sent them to give the believers good news of reward, warn the unbelievers of punishment and teach their people their religion. Those to whom they were sent must obey and follow them. Muhammad ﷺ was the final prophet whom He sent to all mankind.
5. **Belief in the Last Day:** A Muslim believes in Resurrection Day. He believes that Allah will raise the dead from their graves on that day and judge and repay them according to their deeds. Some will enter Paradise while others will enter Hell.
6. **Belief in the divine decree:** A Muslim believes that everything in this universe, whether good or evil, happens according to Allah’s decree, that He foreknows all events which He has already written in the Preserved Tablet, and that everything in this universe happens according to His will.

passages.heading: Stories of the Prophets in the Qur’an
passages.text:
The Holy Qur’an is replete with stories of the previous prophets and their people, starting with Adam, and passing through Noah, Hud, Saalih, Shu’ayb, Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Jesus, and other prophets and messengers, peace be upon them all. The Holy Qur’an mentions their stories for a number of reasons, including the following:

- to show that the religion of all the prophets is, in essence, the same and that its basis is to worship Allah Almighty alone.
- to give solace to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and make him stand firm and steadfast, reminding him that prophets before him suffered the same hardships he himself was experiencing.
- to give comfort and solace to the believers, reminding them that even Allah’s honourable servants before them were afflicted with trials and tribulations.
- to afford people the opportunity to learn lessons from such true stories.

passages.heading: Benefits of Faith
passages.text:
* **Getting to know Allah Almighty:** A believer gets to know his Lord and His names, attributes and actions, so much so that he becomes more attached to Him.
* **Glorying Allah:** the more a believer gets to know his Lord, the more he extols and loves Him, the more he hopes for His mercy and the more God-fearing he becomes.
* **Getting to know Allah’s graciousness to His servants:** for sending messengers to them and divine books to them to guide them to the true religion.
* **Loving the angels:** for worshipping Allah and showing obedience to Him.
* **Loving Allah’s Messengers:** Allah Almighty chose them to convey His message to people.
* **Diligent worship:** the stronger the faith, the more worship one performs.
* **A truly happy life:** A believer is content with what Allah has apportioned to him and knows that whatever calamities befall him in this world elevate his rank and efface his sins. He also hopes for the bliss He has prepared for the believers in the life to come.
* **Not to be deluded by this world:** The life of this world is temporary and only serves as a means to eternal life in the hereafter.
* **Exposing myths:** Faith exposes and nullifies many myths.
* **Entering Paradise:** This is the abode of eternal bliss which Allah Almighty has prepared for His believing servants.

passages.heading: *Soorat An-Naas* Explained
passages.text:
“Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind”

Say, Messenger, “I seek refuge and protection in Allah, the Lord of all mankind, who alone has power over all things.

“the King of mankind”

The King of all people, who manages all their affairs.

“the God of mankind”

The True God of all people, who alone deserves to be worshipped by them.

“from the evil of the slinking whisperer”

from the harm of Satan who whispers evil suggestions to people when they are heedless of Allah and refrains from doing so when they remember Him.

“who whispers into the hearts of mankind”

who whispers evil suggestions and thoughts into people’s chests and controls their feelings and thoughts.

“from among the jinn and mankind”

from the devils among the jinn and mankind.

passages.text:
*Soorat Al-Kawthar* **Explained**

{{Q:108:1-3}}

“We have bestowed on you abundant good”

We have given you, Messenger, immeasurable, abundant good in this life and the life to come, part of which is River Al-Kawthar in Paradise.

“So pray to your Lord and sacrifice to Him”

Therefore, sincerely pray to your Lord and worship Him alone, and sacrifice to Him, pronouncing Allah’s name alone when slaughtering animals, in gratitude to Him for the honour and good He has bestowed on you.

“He who hates you is the one who is truly cut off”

*Shaani’aka*: The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought.

The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought is the most disgraced and contemptible, whose mention is short-lived and who is cut off from all good.

passages.text: We pay *zakaat* in compliance with the command of Allah who has enjoined us to pay it.

passages.text: to purify one’s heart from over-attachment to wealth and from selfish greed

passages.heading: Que dois-je faire si je trouve de l’eau après avoir effectué l’ablution sèche ?
passages.text: Si le musulman trouve de l’eau ou il est capable de l’utiliser, alors sa purification devient invalide et il doit effectuer l’ablution, ou le lavage après cela.

passages.heading: Comment effectuer l’ablution ?
passages.text:
1. Il doit avoir l’intention d’effectuer l’ablution dans son cœur et dire : “Au nom d’Allah.“
2. Il se lave les mains avec de l’eau, en commençant par la [main] droite.
3. Il se lave la bouche en ingurgitant de l’eau, en la gargarisant et ensuite en la recrachant. [En arabe] On appelle cela : “Al Madmadah“
4. Il se lave le nez en aspirant de l’eau et ensuite en l’expirant en faisant ressortir l’air de son nez.
5. Il doit se laver complètement le visage : dans ses limites en longueur, de la racine des cheveux en haut du front jusqu’au bas du menton, ainsi que les poils de la barbe, s’il y en a ; et dans ses limites en largeur, d’une oreille à l’autre.
6. Il se lave les mains, des extrémités des doigts jusqu’à l’articulation du coude, en commençant par la droite.
7. Il mouille ses mains avec de l’eau, puis il s’essuie la tête, en commençant de l’avant de la tête jusqu’à la nuque, puis il revient avec ses mains vers l’avant.
8. Il s’essuie les oreilles avec ses index à l’intérieur des oreilles et il essuie [en même temps] derrière les oreilles avec ses pouces.
9. Il se lave les pieds jusqu’aux chevilles, qui sont les deux os saillants de l’articulation du pied, en commençant par son pied droit.

passages.heading: Quand le lavage est-il obligatoire ?
passages.text:
Le lavage est obligatoire pour le musulman dans trois cas :

1. L’éjaculation de sperme avec désir, qu’elle ait eu lieu en état d’éveil ou pendant le sommeil.
2. Le rapport sexuel, qu’il y ait eu éjaculation ou pas.
3. La perte du sang des menstrues ou des lochies chez la femme. Et dès lors où le sang ne coule plus, alors la femme doit se laver.

passages.heading: La signification de l’ablution :
passages.text: L’ablution est le lavage du visage, des mains et des pieds mais aussi l’essuyage de la tête d’une manière précise.

passages.heading: Nombre de fois du lavage des membres de l’ablution :
passages.text: La Tradition prophétique (Sounna) dans l’ablution consiste à laver chaque membre [du corps] trois fois, excepté l’essuyage de la tête et les oreilles, qui se fait une seule fois. Il est permis de se contenter d’un seul lavage du membre à condition qu’il soit lavé en entier.

passages.heading: L’ablution sèche :
passages.text: Celui qui est incapable d’effectuer l’ablution ou le lavage par absence d’eau ou par incapacité d’utiliser de l’eau en raison d’une maladie ou d’autre chose, celui-ci doit alors effectuer l’ablution sèche. La description de l’ablution sèche est la suivante : Avoir l’intention dans son cœur de faire cette ablution sèche, frapper ses mains sur la terre d’un seul coup, ensuite s’essuyer avec ce qui reste de traces de la terre dans ses mains [en passant] sur son visage, puis s’essuyer les paumes des mains.

passages.heading: Jugements concernant les menstrues et les lochies :
passages.text:
Allah (Exalté et Magnifié soit-Il) a prescrit pour la femme en état de menstrues ou de lochies divers jugements, notamment :

- Le non-accomplissement de la prière. Ainsi, elles n’ont pas l’obligation d’effectuer la prière pendant la période de menstruation et celle post-partum ni elles ont à rattraper la prière après la fin des menstrues et des lochies.
- Le non-accomplissement du jeûne. En effet, le jeûne ne leur est pas permis pendant la période de menstrues et de lochies. Toutefois, elles doivent rattraper les jours non jeûnés durant le mois de Ramadan.
- L’interdiction de tout rapport sexuel. Il n’est pas permis au mari d’avoir des rapports sexuels avec son épouse en état de menstrues ou de lochies jusqu’à ce qu’elle se lave après la fin de ses menstrues et lochies. Toutefois, il est permis au mari de jouir d’elle sans avoir de rapport sexuel.
- Le lavage après l’arrêt du saignement. Si l’écoulement du sang s’arrête chez la femme ayant ses règles ou ses lochies, elle doit alors se laver comme mentionné précédemment.

passages.heading: La purification abstraite :
passages.text:
C’est le fait de de débarrasser de toute cause empêchant l’accomplissement de la prière, et cela en lavant les parties du corps ou en lavant tout le corps.

La purification physique se fait soit par l’ablution ou par le lavage.

- Ce qui est signifié par l’ablution est le lavage de certaines parties du corps avec de l’eau.
- Ce qui est signifié par le lavage est le fait de laver l’ensemble du corps avec de l’eau.

On emploie de l’eau pure pour la purification, comme l’eau de la mer, des rivières ou des fleuves, des puits, etc. parmi les eaux qui n’ont pas été mélangées à de la souillure.

passages.heading: Comment effectuer l’ablution ?
passages.text: Lorsque le musulman souhaite effectuer son ablution, alors il doit l’effectuer selon les étapes suivantes :

passages.heading: Les annulatifs de l’ablution :
passages.text:
L’ablution est annulée par l’un des quatre cas suivants :

- La sortie d’un corps par l’un des deux orifices, comme : un gaz, ou de l’urine, ou des selles, ou du sperme, ou le liquide qui accompagne le désir sexuel.
- La disparition de la raison par le sommeil ou l’ivresse.
- Toucher ses parties intimes avec désir et de manière directe.
- La consommation de la viande de chameau.

passages.heading: Description du lavage complet :
passages.text:
Lorsque le musulman souhaite effectuer un lavage complet, il doit accomplir les étapes suivantes :

1. Avoir l’intention du lavage dans son cœur, puis rincer ses parties intimes avec de l’eau.
2. Effectuer l’ablution comme pour celle de la prière.
3. Se laver l’ensemble du corps avec de l’eau.

passages.heading: Discute
passages.text: Qu’est-ce qu’indique la directive de se laver pour ôter l’impureté majeure ?

passages.heading: Ce qui est interdit à la personne en état d’impureté majeure de faire:
passages.text:
Le cas d’une personne qui est obligée d’effectuer le lavage à cause d’un rapport sexuel ou de l’éjaculation s’appelle : “ Al Janâbah “ et la personne qui est dans cet état d’impureté se dit : “ Junub “. Dans cet état-là, il lui est interdit :

1. La prière.
2. La circumambulation autour de la Ka’bah.
3. Le fait de toucher le Coran.
4. Le fait de rester à la mosquée.
5. La lecture du noble Coran.

passages.heading: Avant-propos
passages.text: L’ablution prend son importance en Islam en raison de son lien étroit avec le précepte de la prière qui est considéré comme le plus immense des préceptes de l’Islam, et à partir de là, le musulman devrait être assidu à l’apprendre et à s’en acquitter de la bonne manière. Et dans cette leçon, nous allons apprendre la signification de l’ablution (mineure), les causes qui la rendent obligatoire, ses annulatifs et sa manière authentique [de l’effectuer].

passages.heading: Ce qui rend obligatoire l’ablution :
passages.text:
Ce qui rend obligatoire l’ablution sont les choses pour lesquelles l’ablution est requise et pour laquelle elle est obligatoire. Et lorsqu’une personne perd son ablution certaines choses sont interdites, notamment :

> L’impureté est une description abstraite chez la personne qui l’empêche de s’acquitter de la prière avant de se purifier. Ce n’est pas quelque chose de physique comme la souillure. L’impureté est de deux types : La première d’entre elle oblige le musulman à effectuer l’ablution pour s’en débarrasser tandis que l’autre ne s’enlève que par le lavage.

1. La prière
2. La circumambulation autour de la Ka’bah
3. Toucher le Coran

passages.text: ## L’ablution mineure (Al Wouḍoû)

passages.heading: Discute
