passages.heading: Who is the prophet of Islam?
passages.text: Muslims believe that Muhammad ﷺ is the Last Prophet whom Allah has sent to all mankind to call them to worship Allah alone and to declare that Muhammad is His Last Prophet. Allah Almighty says, {{Q:33:40}} (Soorat Al-Ahzaab, 33:40)

passages.heading: The Meaning of *Ghusl*
passages.text: *Ghusl*: Washing the entire body with water to remove the major ritual impurity.

passages.heading: Lesson 4
passages.text: ## Ghusl (Full Ablutions/Bath)

passages.heading: The Manner of Performing the Full Ritual Bath (*Ghusl*)
passages.text:
If a Muslim wants to perform *ghusl*, he must do the following:

1. He intends in his heart to perform *ghusl* and washes out his private parts with water.
2. He performs *wudoo’* like the one he performs before the prayer.
3. He washes his entire body with water.

passages.text: A Muslim must perform *ghusl* in three cases:

passages.text: What do you think would happen if all the rich Muslims paid *zakaat* due on all their wealth?

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: What purposes does clothing serve?

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
With your partners, discuss the reasons why some types of clothing are forbidden in Islam.

The Prophet ﷺ forbade men from imitating women and women from imitating men. This prohibition includes the type of clothing and the manner of speech. Islam strictly forbids imitation of the opposite sex, considering it a major sin that invites Allah’s punishment unless one repents and desists from committing it. Islam enjoins men to ensure that their true nature and appearance are distinct from that of women, and vice versa, which clearly testifies to common sense and sound logic.

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: Can we turn to fashion trends, customs, traditions or official regulations to determine for us what the appropriate clothing for men and women is?

passages.heading: Soorat Al-Kawthar (Abundant Good)
passages.text:
*Soorat Al-Kawthar* **Explained**

{{Q:108:1-3}}

“We have bestowed on you abundant good”

We have given you, Messenger, immeasurable, abundant good in this life and the life to come, part of which is River Al-Kawthar in Paradise.

“So pray to your Lord and sacrifice to Him”

Therefore, sincerely pray to your Lord and worship Him alone, and sacrifice to Him, pronouncing Allah’s name alone when slaughtering animals, in gratitude to Him for the honour and good He has bestowed on you.

“He who hates you is the one who is truly cut off”

*Shaani’aka*: The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought.

The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought is the most disgraced and contemptible, whose mention is short-lived and who is cut off from all good.

passages.heading: How Do We Pray?
passages.text: If a Muslim wants to pray, he must do the following:

passages.heading: *Soorat Al-Kaafiroon* Explained
passages.text:
{{Q:109:1-6}}

“Say: Unbelievers!”

Say, Messenger, to those who disbelieve in Allah and His Messenger: You unbelievers.

“I do not worship what you worship”

I do not worship the false gods, such as idols, that you worship.

“nor do you worship what I worship”

nor do you worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

“I will never worship what you worship”

I will never worship the false gods that you worship.

“nor will you ever worship what I worship”

nor will you ever worship the True God whom I worship, and who alone is worthy of worship.

Al-kaafir: The person who does not proclaim pure monotheism and does not follow the divine message Prophet Muhammad ﷺ has brought.

“You have your religion, and I have my religion”

You have your religion to which you adhere, and I have my religion to which I adhere.

passages.heading: The Requirements of the Two Testimonies of Faith
passages.text: It is not enough to verbally declare the two testimonies of faith. In addition to this, it is imperative to know what they mean and to meet their requirements. The testimony that there is no god but Allah requires us to reject everything that is worshipped besides or instead of Allah, to firmly believe that Allah alone is our Lord and Cherisher and the One True God worthy of worship and to worship Him sincerely. Allah Almighty says, {{Q:2:256}} (Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:256) The testimony that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah requires us to believe what he says, do what he commands and avoid what he forbids and worship Allah only according to his instructions.

passages.heading: How Many Times Do We Wash the Parts of the Body that Are Usually Washed in *Wudoo’*?
passages.text: According to the *Sunnah*, each part of the body is washed three times, except in the case of the head and ears, which are wiped only once. It would suffice, however, to wash these body parts once provided that they are washed thoroughly.

passages.heading: What shall I do if I find water after having performed *tayammum*?
passages.text: If a Muslim finds water or can use it, his purity becomes invalid, in which case he must perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl*.

passages.heading: Things That a Person Who Is in a State of *Jannabah* Must Not Do
passages.text:
The state into which a person gets following intercourse or ejaculation and because of which he must perform *ghusl* is called *janaabah*, and he is described as *junub*. In this case, he is not allowed to do the following:

1. perform the prayer
2. circumambulate the Ka’bah (*tawaaf*)
3. touch or carry the Qur’an
4. stay in the mosque
5. read the Qur’an

passages.heading: How Do We Pay *Zakaat* Due on Cash?
passages.text: A Muslim pays *zakaat* due on his cash once a year. 2.5% of its value must be given out as *zakaat*.

passages.heading: What Is the Qur’an?
passages.text:
The Holy Qur’an is the Word of Allah Almighty that He revealed to His Messenger, Muhammad ﷺ. It is the last of Allah’s revealed books, and there is no other book after it.

The revealed books are the books that Allah Almighty revealed to His prophets.
A Muslim believes that these books were revealed by Allah Almighty, and that Allah spoke in them in a manner that befits Him. These books include Az-Zaboor (the Psalms), which He revealed to Daawood (David) عليه السلام; At-Tawraat (the Torah), which He revealed to Moosaa (Moses) عليه السلام and Al-Injeel (the Gospel), which He revealed to Jesus, عليه السلام. All these books have undergone alteration and corruption through the ages.

passages.heading: The Five Obligatory Prayers
passages.text:
Allah Almighty has enjoined Muslims to perform five prayers throughout the day and night, namely:

| The Prayer | Beginning Time | Ending Time | Number of units (*rak‘ahs*) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| *Fajr* (Dawn) Prayer | at the break of dawn | sunrise | 2 |
| *Dhuhr* (Midday) Prayer | when the sun starts declining westward at midday after reaching its zenith | when the shadow of an object becomes equal in length to the object itself | 4 |
| *‘Asr* (Late Afternoon) Prayer | when the shadow of an object becomes equal in length to the object itself | sunset | 4 |
| *Maghrib* (Sunset) Prayer | sunset | when the red glow (evening twilight) on the western horizon disappears | 3 |
| *‘Ishaa’* (Late Evening) Prayer | when the red glow (evening twilight) on the western horizon disappears | midnight | 4 |

passages.heading: How Do We Pray?
passages.text:
1. He intends in his heart to pray.
2. He stands facing the *qiblah*, raises his hands up to the level of the shoulders or ears, and says, “*Allaahu akbar* Allah is the Greatest.”
3. He places his right hand on his left hand. Then he recites one of the opening supplications, such as, Subhaanak-Allaahumma wa bi hamdika, wa tabaarak-asmuka, wa ta’aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka “Glory be to You, O Allah; Yours is the praise, blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god besides You.” Then he says, A’oodhu billaahi min-ash-shaytaan-ir-rajeem. Bismillaah-ir-rahmaan-ir-raheem “I seek Allah’s protection from Satan, who has been expelled from His mercy. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.” Then he recites *Soorat Al-Faatihah* and says after it, “*Aameen*”, which means “Answer our supplications, O Allah”. After that, he recites whatever number of verses of the Qur’an as is easy for him, even if it is one verse.
4. He says, “Allaahu akbar Allah is the Greatest” while raising his hands up to the level of his shoulders or ears, and bows down, lowering his head and back and keeping them straight at a right angle, placing the palms of his hands on the knees. He says three times while in this position, “Subhaana rabbiy-al-’adheem Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty.”

5. He resumes the standing position, raising his hands up to the level of the shoulders or the ears, saying: Sami’allaahu li man hamidah “Allah hears those who praise Him.” Then he says while standing: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd “Our Lord, to You is due all praise.”

6. He says, Allaahu akbar “Allah is the Greatest” and prostrates himself, with the toes of both feet, the knees, the palms of the hands and the forehead and the nose touching the floor. He says three times while in this position, “Glory be to my Lord, Most High.”

passages.heading: *Soorat An-Naas* Explained
passages.text:
“Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind”

Say, Messenger, “I seek refuge and protection in Allah, the Lord of all mankind, who alone has power over all things.

“the King of mankind”

The King of all people, who manages all their affairs.

“the God of mankind”

The True God of all people, who alone deserves to be worshipped by them.

“from the evil of the slinking whisperer”

from the harm of Satan who whispers evil suggestions to people when they are heedless of Allah and refrains from doing so when they remember Him.

“who whispers into the hearts of mankind”

who whispers evil suggestions and thoughts into people’s chests and controls their feelings and thoughts.

“from among the jinn and mankind”

from the devils among the jinn and mankind.

passages.heading: Lesson 2
passages.text: ## The Interpretation of Short *Surahs*

passages.heading: Soorat Al-Kawthar (Abundant Good)
passages.text:
*Soorat Al-Kawthar* **Explained**

{{Q:108:1-3}}

“We have bestowed on you abundant good”

We have given you, Messenger, immeasurable, abundant good in this life and the life to come, part of which is River Al-Kawthar in Paradise.

“So pray to your Lord and sacrifice to Him”

Therefore, sincerely pray to your Lord and worship Him alone, and sacrifice to Him, pronouncing Allah’s name alone when slaughtering animals, in gratitude to Him for the honour and good He has bestowed on you.

“He who hates you is the one who is truly cut off”

*Shaani’aka*: The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought.

The one who hates you and hates the true religion you have brought is the most disgraced and contemptible, whose mention is short-lived and who is cut off from all good.

passages.heading: The Manner of Performing *Wudoo’*
passages.text:
1. He intends in his heart to perform *wudoo’* and says, *bismillaah* “In the name of Allah”.
2. He washes his hands up to the wrists with water.
3. He rinses out his mouth thoroughly by moving water around in the mouth and then spitting it out. This process is called *madmadah*) in Arabic.
4. He cleans his nose by sniffing water into the nostrils and ejecting it out by blowing his nose.
5. He washes his face thoroughly from the hairline at the top of the forehead to the bottom of the chin, along with the beard, if he is bearded, and from ear to ear.
6. He washes his hands from the fingertips up to the elbow, starting with his right hand.
7. With wet hands, and starting with his hands flat on the top of the head near the hairline, he wipes it to the back of the neck and back to the front.
8. With wet fingers, he wipes  
He wipes the inner sides of the ears with his index fingers and behind them with his thumbs.
9. He washes his feet up to the ankles, which are the two prominent bones of the joint connecting the foot to the leg, starting with his right foot.

passages.heading: Things That Render *Wudoo’* Invalid
passages.text:
*Wudoo’* becomes invalid as a result of four things:

- Natural discharges from the private parts (both the external genital and excretory organs), such as urine, excrement, wind, semen and the clear, colourless, viscous fluid that is emitted during sexual arousal
- Loss of consciousness due to sleep or intoxication
- Lustfully touching the private parts with bare hands
- Eating camel meat

passages.heading: *Tayammum* (Dry Ablution)
passages.text:
If a person who wants to perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl* is unable to do so due to illness, or when water is not readily available, or for any other legitimate reason, he may resort to dry ablution (*tayammum*) instead.

The Manner of Performing *Tayammum*: (1) Intend in his heart to perform *tayammum* and strike both hands slightly on pure earth once, (2) wipe the face with them, (3) wipe the back of the right hand with the palm of the left, and then the back of the left hand with the palm of the right hand.

passages.heading: What are the types of wealth upon which *zakaat* is due?
passages.text:
- **Gold and silver**
- **All types of currency (banknotes and coins)**
- **Farm produce (crops and fruit)**
- **Grazing livestock**

Grazing livestock: This refers to camels, cattle, sheep and goats.

- **Commercial commodities**

Commercial commodities: all properties owned with the aim of investing them in trade. They generally include assets, such as a house, a shop, a car and an animal.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: When Allah sent prophets to their people to call them to the truth, he supported them with some miracles to prove to them that they were true prophets. These miracles, however, ended with the passing of these prophets. As for the Messenger of Islam ﷺ, Allah also furnished him with certain miracles to show his people, and all mankind, for that matter, but the greatest of all of them was His Glorious Book, which He took upon Himself to preserve even after the demise of His prophet ﷺ. In this lesson, we are going to learn about some virtues and etiquette associated with the Qur’an.

passages.heading: The Virtue of Reading/Reciting the Qur’an
passages.text:
- The Prophet ﷺ said, “If anyone reads/recites one single letter in Allah’s Book, he will be credited with a good deed, and a good deed gets a tenfold reward. I do not say that *alif*, *laam*, *meem* are one letter; rather, *alif* is a letter, *laam* is a letter and *meem* is a letter” (Reported by At-Tirmidhee; No. 2910 with an authentic chain of narrators).

- The Prophet ﷺ also said, “Read the Qur’an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for those who read it.” (Reported by Muslim; No. 804).

passages.heading: Lesson 1
passages.text: ## Learn about the Holy Qur’an

passages.heading: The Qur’an is Food for the Soul and Mind
passages.text:
The Holy Qur’an addresses both people’s minds and souls. It addresses the mind by:

- encouraging them to use logical reasoning on the various issues. The Almighty says, {{Q:21:22}} (Soorat Al-Anbiyyaa’, 21:22).
- calling them to exercise their intellects and contemplate His signs and the proofs of His power. The Almighty says, {{Q:2:219}} (Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:219).
- reproving those who do not use their intellects to reflect on His signs. The Almighty says, {{Q:25:44}} (Soorat Al-Furqaan, 25: 44).

It also addresses the soul and emotions by:

- spotlighting and depicting human feelings in many cases. The Almighty says, {{Q:2:165}} (Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:165).
- calling attention to human emotions and pointing out their good and bad effects. The Almighty says, {{Q:5:82}} (Soorat Al-Maa’idah, 5:82).
- commanding Muslims to exercise kindness and gentleness when inviting others to Islam. The Almighty says, {{Q:16:125}} (Soorat An-Nahl, 16: 125).
- incorporating aspects of faith into verses on legal rules. The Almighty says, {{Q:4:94}} (Soorat An-Nisaa’, 4:94).
- using moving words that evoke genuine emotions. The Almighty says, {{Q:24:22}} (Soorat An-Noor, 24:22).

passages.heading: Certain Rulings on Purification
passages.text:
- It is a general Islamic rule that things are naturally clean and pure unless stated otherwise by Islam.
- It would suffice to cleanse the body or clothing of impurities by removing them with water or any cleaning substance that would serve the purpose.
- It would be better for a person who uses the toilet to cleanse the place of urine and faeces with water. It is also permissible for him to cleanse himself with tissues or any other material that serves to remove impurity.

passages.heading: Types of Purification
passages.text:
Purification falls into two types:

**Physical Purification**

This means the removal of impurities and the cleansing of the area affected by them

**Moral Purification**

This means the removal of those things that prevent one from performing the prayer, by washing certain parts of the body or the entire body.

Physical purification may be undertaken either by *wudoo’* or *ghusl*

*Wudoo’* (partial ablutions): the ritual washing of certain parts of the body with water

*Ghusl* (full ablutions/bath): the ritual washing of the entire body with water.

Purification must be undertaken with pure water, such as seawater, river water, well water, or any other water that has not been mixed with impurity.

passages.heading: What shall I do if I find water after having performed *tayammum*?
passages.text: If a Muslim finds water or can use it, his purity becomes invalid, in which case he must perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl*.

passages.heading: The Manner of Performing the Full Ritual Bath (*Ghusl*)
passages.text:
If a Muslim wants to perform *ghusl*, he must do the following:

1. He intends in his heart to perform *ghusl* and washes out his private parts with water.
2. He performs *wudoo’* like the one he performs before the prayer.
3. He washes his entire body with water.

passages.heading: How to Perform *Ghusl*?
passages.text:
To perform *ghusl*, one must wash the entire body with water, rinse out one’s mouth and clean one’s nose by sniffing water into the nostrils and ejecting it out by blowing one’s nose. A Muslim removes the major ritual impurity by simply doing so.

> The major ritual impurity: what must be removed by ghusl, and ablution is not sufficient, and these are types:
> 
> 1- *Janaabah*: The state of ritual impurity following intercourse or ejaculation as a result of an orgasm even if no intercourse takes place.
> 2- Menstruation: the normal vaginal bleeding that occurs as part of a woman’s monthly cycle.
> 3- Postnatal bleeding: The vaginal bleeding that takes place following childbirth.

passages.heading: The Manner of Performing *Wudoo’*
passages.text:
1. He intends in his heart to perform *wudoo’* and says, *bismillaah* “In the name of Allah”.
2. He washes his hands up to the wrists with water.
3. He rinses out his mouth thoroughly by moving water around in the mouth and then spitting it out. This process is called *madmadah*) in Arabic.
4. He cleans his nose by sniffing water into the nostrils and ejecting it out by blowing his nose.
5. He washes his face thoroughly from the hairline at the top of the forehead to the bottom of the chin, along with the beard, if he is bearded, and from ear to ear.
6. He washes his hands from the fingertips up to the elbow, starting with his right hand.
7. With wet hands, and starting with his hands flat on the top of the head near the hairline, he wipes it to the back of the neck and back to the front.
8. With wet fingers, he wipes  
He wipes the inner sides of the ears with his index fingers and behind them with his thumbs.
9. He washes his feet up to the ankles, which are the two prominent bones of the joint connecting the foot to the leg, starting with his right foot.

passages.heading: The Meaning of *Ghusl*
passages.text: *Ghusl*: Washing the entire body with water to remove the major ritual impurity.

passages.heading: *Tayammum* (Dry Ablution)
passages.text:
If a person who wants to perform *wudoo’* or *ghusl* is unable to do so due to illness, or when water is not readily available, or for any other legitimate reason, he may resort to dry ablution (*tayammum*) instead.

The Manner of Performing *Tayammum*: (1) Intend in his heart to perform *tayammum* and strike both hands slightly on pure earth once, (2) wipe the face with them, (3) wipe the back of the right hand with the palm of the left, and then the back of the left hand with the palm of the right hand.

passages.heading: How Many Times Do We Wash the Parts of the Body that Are Usually Washed in *Wudoo’*?

passages.heading: Siapakah yang Diwajibkan Berhaji?
passages.text: Haji diwajibkan sekali dalam seumur hidup atas umat Islam laki-laki dan perempuan yang mampu. Setiap orang yang mampu untuk berhaji secara fisik dan finansial, maka haji wajib atasnya.

passages.heading: Hijab Muslimah
passages.text:
Allah telah mewajibkan hijab terhadap perempuan, tidak laki-laki, karena perempuan diberikan penampilan indah dan bagian menggoda yang memungkinkannya menjadi fitnah bagi laki-laki lebih dominan daripada laki-laki menjadi fitnah bagi perempuan. Batasan hijab tersebut yaitu menutup seluruh tubuhnya dari laki-laki ajnabi. Perempuan dibolehkan menggunakan model dan warna pakaian apa saja yang disukainya dengan memperhatikan empat ketentuan:

| Pertama: | Kedua: | Ketiga: | Keempat: |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hijab tersebut menutupi semua yang wajib ditutupi. | lebar dan tidak sempit yang dapat membentuk anggota tubuh. | tidak transparan yang menampakkan anggota badan di baliknya. | hijab tersebut bukan sebagai perhiasan. |

Seorang Muslimah wajib menutup seluruh tubuhnya dari pandangan:
a) perempuan lainnya
b) laki-laki ajnabi
c) ayah suami

Perempuan yang haid dan nifas setelah suci diwajibkan mengqada:
a) salat
b) puasa
c) semua yang disebutkan

Islam mewajibkan laki-laki untuk menjaga perempuan serta menafkahinya tanpa mengharapkan imbalan darinya.

Benar Salah

Hijab tidak disyaratkan lebar.

Benar Salah

Bila perempuan yang haid telah suci, maka ia wajib mandi sebelum mengerjakan salat.

Benar Salah

Haid adalah darah alami yang keluar dari rahim perempuan setelah melahirkan.

passages.heading: Kedudukan Perempuan dalam Islam
passages.text:
Beberapa contoh hukum yang terkait dengan penghargaan terhadap perempuan dalam Islam:

- Islam memberikan kepada perempuan haknya dari warisan dengan pembagian yang adil dan mulia; bagiannya setara bagian laki-laki dalam beberapa kondisi dan berbeda bagiannya dari laki-laki di beberapa kondisi yang lain, sesuai dengan hubungan kekerabatannya serta beban nafkah yang ditanggungnya.
- Islam menyetarakan antara laki-laki dan perempuan dalam berbagai urusan, di antaranya dalam semua bentuk muamalat harta.
- Islam memberikan perempuan kebebasan memilih suami.
- Islam menetapkan namanya dan kemuliaan nasabnya kepada bapaknya; yaitu nasabnya tidak berubah setelah menikah, tetapi ia tetap bernasab kepada bapaknya dan keluarganya.
- Islam mewajibkan laki-laki untuk menjaga serta memberinya nafkah tanpa ada imbalan darinya, bila perempuan itu termasuk yang wajib dinafkahi, seperti istri, ibu, dan putrinya.
- Islam menegaskan kemuliaan dan keutamaan menolong perempuan lemah yang tidak memiliki siapa-siapa, walaupun bukan kerabat, serta menganjurkan untuk membantunya dan menjadikan hal tersebut bagian dari amal paling utama di sisi Allah.

passages.heading: Pendahuluan
passages.text: Allah 'Azza wa Jalla telah mengkhususkan perempuan dengan sebagian sifat dan keistimewaan yang membedakannya dari laki-laki, sebagaimana Allah telah mewajibkan kepadanya sebagian ibadah tanpa laki-laki. Pada pelajaran ini kita akan mengenal lebih jauh sebagian hukum-hukum yang khusus pada perempuan Muslimah.

passages.heading: Syarat-syarat Salat
passages.text:
Dalam menunaikan salat diharuskan memenuhi sejumlah syarat, yaitu:

* **Bersuci.** Ini mencakup suci badan dan tempat dari najis, juga suci dari hadas dengan berwudu atau mandi.
* **Menutup aurat.** Aurat adalah semua bagian badan yang wajib ditutup di hadapan orang lain. Aurat laki-laki yang wajib ditutup dalam salat ialah dari pusat hingga lutut. Sedangkan aurat perempuan yang wajib ditutup dalam salat ialah seluruh badannya kecuali muka dan telapak tangan.
* **Menghadap kiblat.** Yaitu mengarah ke Ka’bah al-Musyarrafah yang ada di Makkah al-Mukarramah. Orang yang mengerjakan salat wajib menghadap ke arah Ka’bah dalam salatnya.
* **Masuknya waktu salat.** Salat tidak sah bila dikerjakan sebelum masuk waktunya. Juga tidak boleh diakhirkan hingga lewat waktunya. Yang paling afdal adalah mengerjakannya di awal waktunya.

passages.heading: Hubungan Perempuan dengan Laki-Laki
passages.text:
Hubungan perempuan dengan laki-laki terbagi menjadi tiga:

| Perempuan sebagai istrinya | Perempuan sebagai mahramnya | Perempuan sebagai orang ajnabi baginya. |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Diperbolehkan bagi keduanya apa yang tidak dibolehkan bagi selainnya, seperti melihat dan bersenang-senang. Allah menamakan suami sebagai pakaian bagi istri dan istri sebagai pakaian bagi suami; sebagai potret indah hubungan jiwa, emosional, dan fisik antara keduanya. | Yang dimaksud mahram ialah semua yang diharamkan bagi laki-laki untuk menikahinya dengan pengharaman selamanya, seperti ibu, putri, saudari, putri saudari, putri saudara, saudari ayah, saudari ibu, dan ibu istri. Mereka ini boleh keluar di hadapan mahramnya dengan pakaian yang menampakkan lengan, leher, rambut, dan semisalnya tanpa melampaui batas. | Perempuan ajnabi adalah semua perempuan yang bukan mahramnya, baik merupakan kerabatnya seperti putri paman, putri bibi, istri saudara, dan kerabat keluarga besar, maupun bukan kerabat yang tidak diikat oleh hubungan keluarga. Islam telah meletakkan beberapa aturan untuk interaksi antara laki-laki dan perempuan, seperti wajib berhijab dan tidak berduaan. |

passages.heading: Diskusikan!
passages.text: Diskusikanlah dengan rekan-rekan Anda yang pernah menunaikan kewajiban haji, mintailah mereka keterangan tentang perasaan mereka tatkala menunaikannya.

passages.heading: Macam-macam Darah yang Keluar dari Perempuan
passages.text:
Ada dua macam darah yang keluar dari perempuan:

* **Darah haid**
  yaitu darah alami yang keluar dari rahim perempuan setiap bulan secara umum dan berlanjut selama beberapa hari. Ia juga dinamakan kebiasaan bulanan.

* **Darah nifas**
  yaitu darah alami yang keluar dari rahim perempuan setelah janin keluar dan berlanjut selama beberapa hari, terkadang sampai 40 hari.

passages.heading: Hukum-hukum Terkait Haid dan Nifas
passages.text:
Allah *‘Azza wa Jalla* telah mensyariatkan sejumlah hukum bagi wanita haid dan nifas, di antaranya:

■ Kewajiban salat gugur dari keduanya. Keduanya tidak wajib mengerjakan salat selama masa haid dan nifas, dan keduanya tidak wajib mengqada salat tersebut setelah haid dan nifas selesai.

■ Meninggalkan puasa. Keduanya tidak boleh berpuasa selama masa haid dan nifas, tetapi keduanya wajib mengqada puasa hari-hari yang ditinggalkan di bulan Ramadan.

■ Haram berhubungan badan. Suami tidak boleh melakukan hubungan badan dengan istrinya yang sedang haid ataupun nifas sampai ia mandi wajib ketika haid dan nifasnya selesai, tetapi suami boleh untuk mencumbuinya tanpa melakukan sanggama di kemaluan.

■ Wajib mandi setelah darah berhenti. Ketika darah berhenti keluar, baik haid ataupun nifas, maka wanita itu wajib mandi sebagaimana telah disebutkan.

passages.heading: Quando devo repetir a ablução?
passages.text: Se um muçulmano realiza ablução, o princípio básico é que sua ablução permaneça até que aconteça algo do que necessita a ablução, do que foi mencionado anteriormente.

passages.heading: Qual é a condição para o sacrificio do animal segundo a Shariah?
passages.text:
Sacrificio islâmico é o abate ou sacrifício que cumpre as seguintes condições:

1. Que o matador seja muçulmano, judeu ou cristão, e pretenda sacrificar.
2. Que a máquina seja própria para abate e que escorra o sangue e corte afiado como uma faca, e é proibido usar qualquer coisa que a mate por ser pesada ou bater na cabeça do animal, ou queimá-lo como o choque elétrico.
3. Mencionar o nome de ALLAH e dizer: (Em nome de ALLAH) ao mover a mão para o abate.
4. Cortar o que deve ser cortado no sacrifício, a saber: o esôfago, a garganta e as veias jugulares, que são as duas veias principais do pescoço, ou cortar três dessas quatro.

passages.heading: Prefácio
passages.text:
Islam: É a religião com a qual ALLAH enviou Muhammad, que a paz e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, e é uma extensão do que os mensageiros anteriores trouxeram. Sua essência é baseada no fato de que a divindade merecedora de adoração é uma e não tem um parceiro, e é ALLAH, o Exaltado, o Majestoso, e não há ajudante para Ele em Seu domínio, e não há mediador entre Ele e Seus servos.

Mas por que devo me converter ao Islam? É uma religião para todos ou específica para os árabes? E quem é o seu profeta? Existe outro profeta que virá depois dele?

passages.heading: Quem é o profeta do Islam?
passages.text: O muçulmano acredita que Muhammad, que a paz esteja e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, é o selo dos profetas que ALLAH enviou ao povo para chamá-los para adorá-lo somente e mais ninguém, e que não há profeta depois dele; ALLAH disse -: {{Q:33:40}} [Al-Ahzab: 40]

passages.heading: Associar parceiros a ALLAH:
passages.text:
É a crença na divindade em alguém além de ALLAH Todo-Poderoso, ou aproximar-se dele com alguma forma de adoração. É um grande pecado, e um grande crime, que ALLAH Todo-Poderoso não perdoará, como disse ALLAH o Altíssimo: {{Q:4:48}} As mulheres:48

Por Alcorão e Sunnah, quer dizer: o Nobre Alcorão e os Hadiths do Profeta Muhammad, que a paz e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, pois são as duas principais fontes de legislação no Islam.

Al-Lawh Al-Mahfuz: É o livro no qual ALLAH escreveu o que está decretado para as criaturas até a Hora da Ressurreição.

passages.heading: Quando devo fazer Ghussl?
passages.text:
Ghussl é obrigatório para um muçulmano em três casos:

**A primeira:**  
A emissão de sêmen por desejo, seja ele emitido estando acordado ou durante o sono.

**A segunda:**  
Relação sexual, se a ejaculação do sêmen ocorreu com ele ou não.

**Terceiro:**  
O sangramento da menstruação ou sangramento pós-parto em uma mulher, e se o sangramento parar, ela deve realizar o ghussl.

passages.heading: 2 O Islam apaga o que precedeu de pecados
passages.text:
Quando a pessoa abraça um verdadeiro Islam; ALLAH, o Clemente, o Misericordioso, perdoa todos os seus pecados passados, e esta é uma das belezas do Islam. O Todo-Poderoso disse ao Seu Profeta ﷺ: {{Q:8:38}} [Al-Anfal: 38]

Um homem veio querendo se submeter ao Profeta, que a paz e as bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, mas ele estipulou que ele fosse perdoado pelo que havia passado, então ele, que a paz e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, deu-lhe boas novas e disse-lhe: Acaso não sabes que o Islam apaga o que antecedeu? Musslim 121

passages.heading: A EXCELÊNCIA DO CARÁTER
passages.text:
* O Profeta, que a paz e as bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, disse que as coisas que mais admitem as pessoas no Paraíso: temor a ALLAH e bom caráter.
* E ele disse, que a paz e as bênçãos estejam com ele, que a mais pesada das boas ações que serão colocadas na balança de uma pessoa no Dia da Ressurreição serão boas maneiras.
* E ele disse, que a paz e as bênçãos estejam com ele, que os crentes mais próximos dele no Dia da Ressurreição serão aqueles com a melhor moral.

> A balança do homem: Isso será no Dia da Ressurreição, quando os bons e maus do homem serão pesados em uma balança particular, e ninguém conhece sua forma ou tamanho, então quem supera suas boas ações entrará no Paraíso, e quem supera suas más ações entrará no inferno.

passages.heading: Discuta
passages.text: Numere alguns meios para aprender a ablução e aplicá-la corretamente?

passages.heading: Passar a mão molhada sobre as meias
passages.text:
Se a pessoa que está realizando a ablução estiver usando meias nas duas pernas, é permitido que ela apenas limpe com as mãos molhadas a parte superior dos pés, e não há necessidade de tirá-las e lavar os pés.

Três condições são necessárias para isso:

**Primeiro:**
Vestir as meias em estado de pureza.

**Segundo:**
Que a meia cubra o pé com os tornozelos.

**Terceiro:**
Que o período de limpeza não ultrapasse (24 horas) para o residente, ou (72 horas) para o viajante.

A duração da limpeza sobre as meias começa a partir do momento da primeira limpeza.

passages.heading: Comes e bebes proibidos
passages.text:
ALLAH Todo-Poderoso proibiu vários tipos de comidas, incluindo:

- O álcool, pois adormece a mente, e preservar a mente é um dos propósitos da lei islâmica.
- Drogas, pois elas destroem a mente e o corpo.
- Todos animais que morreram sem abate, ou que o nome de ALLAH não foi mencionado no momento do abate.
- Porco, pois é uma carne impura que não é permitida comer.
- Predadores; Como leões, tigres, falcões e águias.
- O que foi sacrificado para falsas divindades; como ídolos.

Os propósitos da Sharia:
Uma ciência das ciências islâmicas, a partir da qual a regra da religião é conhecida, e os segredos da Sharia, tais como: Por que ALLAH legislou essas regras? Para que foi essa decisão?

passages.heading: Qual é a decisão sobre comer animais marinhos?
passages.text:
Animais aquáticos que vivem apenas na água, é permitido comer seus mortos, como peixes e camarões e assim por diante, quer vivam em mares, rios ou lagos.

É permitido caçar e comer animais selvagens que não sejam predatórios, desde que o nome de ALLAH seja mencionado durante a caça e abatido se os encontrar vivos.

passages.heading: Regras de animais em restaurantes e lojas:
passages.text:
1. O que foi sacrificado por um não-muçulmano ou um cristão (judeu ou cristão); Como budistas, hindus e pessoas não religiosas, isso é proibido e inclui o que é encontrado em restaurantes e lojas em países cujos residentes são principalmente não-muçulmanos nem pessoas do livro.
2. O que um muçulmano ou um do povo do livro abate à maneira islâmica, isso é permitido de acordo com o texto do Alcorão.
3. O que um muçulmano ou cristão mata ilegalmente, como eletrocussão ou afogamento, é proibido.
4. O princípio básico é que é permitido consumir o que um judeu ou cristão sacrificou e é oferecido em seus restaurantes e lojas, com o cuidado de mencionar o nome de ALLAH ao comer. É melhor para um muçulmano não comer nada, exceto o que é verificado como carne permitida e halal.

passages.heading: Discuta
passages.text:
Navegue com seus colegas em alguns dos sites na Internet que o ajudam a definir alimentos permitidos em seu país.

As regras sobre sacrifícios que são vendidos em lojas e restaurantes variam de acordo com a religião da pessoa que os abateu.

passages.heading: Por que devo abraçar o Islam?
passages.text:
**Algumas pessoas podem perguntar: Por que devo converter?**

A resposta: devo me submeter por causa de uma série de coisas, incluindo:

**A primeira:** que a religião Islâmica é a religião que Allah aprovou para Seus servos, e não é aceita de ninguém outra religião além dessa. O Todo-Poderoso disse:

{{Q:3:85}} Ál-Imran: 85

**A segunda:** que a religião Islâmica é a religião de todos os profetas, e ordena a fé em todos os profetas, e não diferencia entre eles. ALLAH disse:

Dizei: {{Q:2:136}} [Al-Baqarah:136]

A diferença entre os profetas é uma diferença nas decisões legislativas relacionadas às ações dos servos, como disse o Todo-Poderoso: {{Q:5:48}} [Al-Maidah: 48]

passages.heading: Por que devo abraçar o Islam?
passages.text: Isto é: ALLAH fez para cada nação uma lei à qual eles apelam, e uma maneira de se aproximar d’Ele, pois cada povo de um credo tem regras que lhes dizem respeito e legislação que lhes convém. Quanto à crença, a crença dos profetas é a mesma. Então ALLAH enviou o Selo de Seus Profetas e Mensageiros, Muhammad, que a paz e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, e Ele selou os Mensageiros com ele, e selou as leis de Sua lei, então nenhuma outra religião é aceita que não seja o Islam.

**A terceira:** Entrar no Islam é o caminho para a felicidade neste mundo e a salvação na outra vida, então não será salvo aquele que veio depois do Profeta Muhammad, que ALLAH o abençoe e lhe dê paz, e não crer na sua mensagem (e não seguiu), exceto aqueles que nele crêem e o seguem, disse o Todo-Poderoso: {{Q:3:85}} Al-Imran: 85

E disse: Por Aquele em Cuja mão está a vida de Muhammad, nenhum judeu ou cristão ouve sobre mim, em seguida não afirma sua crença naquilo com que fui enviado e morre neste estado (de descrença), sem que seja um dos habitantes do Fogo do Inferno. Narrado por Musslim 153.

**Quarto:** o Islam dá respostas satisfatórias às minhas principais perguntas: Por que vim a este mundo? De onde vim? E para onde vou depois da morte?

**Quinto:** o Islam é uma religião compatível com o instinto, começando com o grande valor nele, que é a unicidade de ALLAH Todo-Poderoso, e terminando com sua etiqueta que orienta para um caráter bom e correto.

passages.heading: Discuta
passages.text: Como respondes àqueles que acham que o Islam é uma religião específica dos árabes?

passages.heading: Aprenda a religião
passages.text:
- É dever do muçulmano aprender com profundidade a sua religião no que ele precisa, a fim de adorar seu Senhor com conhecimento.

- O profeta ﷺ incentivou a aprender a religião, dizendo: “Aquele a quem Allah deseja o bem (por assim merecer) concede o conhecimento da fé e da religião.” [Narrado por Bukhari].

- O Profeta, que a paz e as bênçãos estejam com ele, disse que buscar o conhecimento islâmico é uma maneira de entrar no Paraíso. Ele, que a paz e bênçãos de ALLAH estejam com ele, disse: “Àquela pessoa que buscar um caminho para obter conhecimento, Allah lhe facilitará, por isso, um caminho para o Paraíso.”
  Musslim 2699

passages.heading: O critério de superioridade no Islam
passages.text:
ALLAH Todo-Poderoso fez o critério para a diferenciação entre Seus servos em fé e piedade, de modo que a distinção entre os muçulmanos é baseada na força de sua fé, e não em suas formas, nem sua linhagem, nem suas cores, nem seu dinheiro, como o Todo-Poderoso disse: {{Q:49:13}} [Al-Hujurát:13]

E o Profeta ﷺ disse: “Ó gente, vosso Senhor é um e vosso pai é um. Não há superioridade de um árabe em relação a um não árabe, nem de um não árabe em relação a um árabe, e nem pele branca sobre pele negra, nem pele negra sobre pele branca, exceto pelo temor. Narrado por Baihaqi no (livro) Shuab al-íman 4774/2619

passages.heading: Discuta
passages.text: Como deve ser a moral de um muçulmano com os outros? Essa moral tem um impacto em seu julgamento sobre o Islam?

passages.heading: A ética no Islam não tem apenas um campo
passages.text:
**mas tem muitos campos, que são:**

- Ética com ALLAH Todo-Poderoso; Como o temor de ALLAH e devoção a Ele.
- Ética com a Sharia; Como entrega das disposições da Sharia e reverência.
- Ética consigo mesmo; Como a calma em levá-los à obediência e firmeza em proibir a preguiça.
- Moral com os outros; Como honestidade e confiança.
- Moral com animais; Como o cuidado e não bater ou torturá-la.
- Ética com o meio ambiente; Como preservá-lo da poluição, plantar árvores e não desperdiçar sua riqueza.

passages.heading: How Do We Pray?
passages.text:
1. He intends in his heart to pray.
2. He stands facing the *qiblah*, raises his hands up to the level of the shoulders or ears, and says, “*Allaahu akbar* Allah is the Greatest.”
3. He places his right hand on his left hand. Then he recites one of the opening supplications, such as, Subhaanak-Allaahumma wa bi hamdika, wa tabaarak-asmuka, wa ta’aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka “Glory be to You, O Allah; Yours is the praise, blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god besides You.” Then he says, A’oodhu billaahi min-ash-shaytaan-ir-rajeem. Bismillaah-ir-rahmaan-ir-raheem “I seek Allah’s protection from Satan, who has been expelled from His mercy. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.” Then he recites *Soorat Al-Faatihah* and says after it, “*Aameen*”, which means “Answer our supplications, O Allah”. After that, he recites whatever number of verses of the Qur’an as is easy for him, even if it is one verse.
4. He says, “Allaahu akbar Allah is the Greatest” while raising his hands up to the level of his shoulders or ears, and bows down, lowering his head and back and keeping them straight at a right angle, placing the palms of his hands on the knees. He says three times while in this position, “Subhaana rabbiy-al-’adheem Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty.”

passages.heading: The Five Obligatory Prayers
passages.text:
Allah Almighty has enjoined Muslims to perform five prayers throughout the day and night, namely:

| The Prayer | Beginning Time | Ending Time | Number of units (*rak‘ahs*) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| *Fajr* (Dawn) Prayer | at the break of dawn | sunrise | 2 |
| *Dhuhr* (Midday) Prayer | when the sun starts declining westward at midday after reaching its zenith | when the shadow of an object becomes equal in length to the object itself | 4 |
| *‘Asr* (Late Afternoon) Prayer | when the shadow of an object becomes equal in length to the object itself | sunset | 4 |
| *Maghrib* (Sunset) Prayer | sunset | when the red glow (evening twilight) on the western horizon disappears | 3 |
| *‘Ishaa’* (Late Evening) Prayer | when the red glow (evening twilight) on the western horizon disappears | midnight | 4 |

passages.heading: 3 Islam is the Final Religion
passages.text: Allah Almighty has made Islam an extension of the previous divinely revealed religions and has approved and chosen it for all mankind until the end of the world. Thus, it is the only true religion on the face of the earth. The Almighty says, {{Q:3:85}} (Soorat Aal-’Imraan, 3:85).

5. He resumes the standing position, raising his hands up to the level of the shoulders or the ears, saying: Sami’allaahu li man hamidah “Allah hears those who praise Him.” Then he says while standing: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd “Our Lord, to You is due all praise.”

6. He says, Allaahu akbar “Allah is the Greatest” and prostrates himself, with the toes of both feet, the knees, the palms of the hands and the forehead and the nose touching the floor. He says three times while in this position, “Glory be to my Lord, Most High.”

passages.heading: The Qur’an is Food for the Soul and Mind
passages.text: It may at times address the mind and the soul at the same time in one single verse which not only convinces the mind through logical reasoning but also arouses human passions. The Almighty says, {{Q:35:3}} (Soorat Faaṭir, 35:3).

passages.heading: The Prayer
passages.text:
11. He turns his face to his right and says: Assalaamu ‘alaykum wa rahmatullaah “May Allah’s peace and mercy be upon you.” Then he turns his face to his left and says the same this. With this, he concludes his prayer.

This manner only applies to a prayer that consists of two units (*rak’ahs*), such as *Fajr* and *Jumu’ah* prayers. If, however, the prayer consists of three units (*rak’ahs*), namely *Maghrib*, or four units (*rak’ahs*), namely *Dhuhr*, *‘Asr* and *‘Ishaa’*, he completes the remaining units after concluding the first *tashahhud*, in the same way he has performed the first *rak’ah* but without reciting anything else after *Soorat Al-Faatihah*, then sits as he has done after the second *rak’ah*, recites the first *tashahhud* and *As-Salaatu Al-Ibraaheemiyyah*, and then concludes the prayer by saying, Assalaamu ‘alaykum wa rahmatullaah May Allah’s peace and mercy be upon you.” first to the right and then to the left.

passages.heading: Shirk
passages.text: Al-Lawh Al-Mahfoodh (the Preserved Tablet) is the book in which Allah has written everything He has decreed for all creation until the Day of Resurrection.

passages.heading: Shirk
passages.text:
This means the act of holding someone or something as equal to Allah and directing acts of worship to them. It is a grave and an unforgivable sin. The Qur’an says, {{Q:4:48}} (Soorat An-Nisaa’, 4:48).

By the phrase “the Book and Sunnah” is meant the Noble Qur’an and the sayings of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, as they are the two main sources of legislation in Islam.

passages.heading: How Do We Pray?
passages.text: If a Muslim wants to pray, he must do the following:

passages.heading: 2 Islam Wipes out the Sins Committed before It
passages.text: If a person sincerely embraces Islam, the Most Gracious and the Most Merciful God will forgive him all his past sins, and this is one of the outstanding merits of Islam. The Almighty says to His Prophet ﷺ, {{Q:8:38}} (Soorat Al-Anfaal, 8:38). A man once showed interest in Islam, and so he went to the Prophet ﷺ but he stipulated that Allah should forgive him his past sins. The Prophet ﷺ gave him the good news, saying, “Don’t you know that Islam wipes out all the sins committed before it?” (Reported by Muslim; No. 121).

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: How would you respond to those who claim that Islam is only for the Arabs?

passages.heading: Who is the prophet of Islam?
passages.text: Muslims believe that Muhammad ﷺ is the Last Prophet whom Allah has sent to all mankind to call them to worship Allah alone and to declare that Muhammad is His Last Prophet. Allah Almighty says, {{Q:33:40}} (Soorat Al-Ahzaab, 33:40)

passages.heading: Learning Your religion
passages.text:
- A Muslim is required to learn his religion based on sound knowledge in order to worship his Lord properly.
- The Prophet ﷺ urges us to study and understand our religion. He once said, “When Allah wishes to bestow His favour on someone, He makes him understand the religion.” (Reported by Al-Bukhaaree; No. 71).
- The Prophet ﷺ states that acquiring religious knowledge leads to Paradise. He once said, “Whoever treads a path in search of knowledge, Allah will ease the way to Paradise for him.” (Saheeh Ibn Hibbaan; No. 84).

passages.heading: Pendahuluan
passages.text: Orang-orang sering dihinggapi berbagai pertanyaan seputar eksistensi manusia. Mereka seringkali bertanya-tanya tentang hakikat kehidupan mereka, asal muasal mereka, faktor keberadaan diri mereka, dan akhir kehidupan mereka. Pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini telah dijawab oleh Islam dengan jawaban yang sangat sempurna.

passages.heading: Siapakah kita?
Di antara hikmah dan faedah zakat ialah:
passages.text:
**Pertama:**
membersihkan jiwa agar tidak bergantung kepada harta serta tidak pelit mengeluarkannya.

**Kedua:**
memperbanyak harta; karena zakat tidak mengurangi harta, tetapi justru menambahnya dan memberikan keberkahan padanya.

**Ketiga:**
membantu orang-orang yang membutuhkan dari kalangan orang miskin, fakir, dan lainnya.

passages.heading: Diskusikan!
passages.text: Sarana-sarana apa saja yang dapat membantu menghafal surah Al-Fātiḥah?

passages.heading: Pendahuluan
passages.text: Sejak dahulu, semenjak manusia ada di atas bumi ini, mereka hidup dengan tingkat kehidupan yang berbeda-beda. Ada orang kaya yang memiliki banyak harta dan ada orang miskin yang tidak mendapatkan makanan pokoknya. Ini adalah satu di antara sunatullah pada alam ini. Tetapi, Islam telah mewajibkan pada harta orang-orang kaya sebuah kewajiban yang harus mereka tunaikan kepada orang-orang miskin untuk membantu mereka serta meringankan tekanan kemiskinan dari mereka. Islam menganjurkan agar seorang Muslim memberikan sebagian hartanya lebih dari kewajibannya, dan menyediakan pahala besar untuk itu yang akan diperoleh oleh seorang Muslim di masa hidupnya dan setelah kematian. Di samping itu, Islam juga menganjurkan berbuat baik kepada orang-orang miskin di semua waktu dan semua keadaan. Juga menganjurkan memberi makan kepada orang-orang yang kelaparan dan memberi pakaian kepada orang-orang yang tidak mendapatkan pakaian. Semua ini bertujuan agar masyarakat Islam saling bahu-membahu dan bersaudara sebagaimana yang Allah inginkan. Pada pelajaran ini kita akan

passages.heading: Buah Keimanan
passages.text: **Keimanan memiliki banyak buah positif, di antaranya:**

passages.heading: Pendahuluan
passages.text: Islam menganjurkan pengikutnya agar berhias dengan akhlak yang baik. Rasulullah ﷺ telah memberikan arahan tentang pentingnya akhlak dalam banyak hadis dan menggandengkan antara banyak ibadah yang ditunaikan oleh seorang Muslim dengan akhlak baik. Muslim yang memiliki akhlak terpuji dijanjikan ganjaran besar di dunia dan akhirat. Pada pelajaran ini, kita akan mengenal lebih jauh urgensi akhlak dalam Islam disertai penjelasan sebagian keutamaannya.

passages.heading: Konsekuensi Dua Kalimat Syahadat
passages.text:
Tidak cukup hanya melafalkan dua kalimat syahadat. Akan tetapi, harus mengerti maknanya serta mengamalkan apa yang menjadi konsekuensinya. Syahadat *lā ilāha illallāh* memiliki konsekuensi berupa ingkar terhadap semua yang disembah selain Allah *Ta’ālā* serta mengimani bahwa Allah saja sebagai tuhan dan sembahan yang berhak terhadap ibadah disertai keikhlasan dalam beribadah kepada-Nya. Allah *Ta’ālā* berfirman, *"Barang siapa ingkar kepada tagut dan beriman kepada Allah, maka sungguh dia telah berpegang (teguh) pada tali yang sangat kuat yang tidak akan putus."* (QS. Al-Baqarah: 256)

Sedangkan konsekuensi syahadat *"muḥammad rasūlullāh"* ialah membenarkan berita yang beliau sampaikan, menaati perintah yang beliau perintahkan atau larangan yang beliau larang, serta Allah tidak diibadahi kecuali dengan syariat yang beliau bawa.

passages.heading: Siapakah kita?
passages.text:
Allah berikan padanya kemungkinan untuk baik dan kemungkinan untuk buruk. Allah juga membekalinya sesuatu untuk membedakan kebaikan dan keburukan, seperti fitrah dan akal.

Allah menjadikannya merdeka, berhak memilih, dan bertanggung jawab terhadap pilihan dan amal perbuatannya.

passages.heading: Pelajaran 1
passages.text: ## Islam dan Tanda Tanya Besar Tentang Kehidupan

passages.heading: Dari mana asal muasal kita dan untuk apa kita hidup?
passages.text:
> **Adam**  
> Allah telah menceritakan kepada kita dalam Al-Qur`ān tentang kisah penciptaan Adam dan bagaimana setan mulai memusuhinya. Silakan lihat tafsir surah Al-Baqarah ayat: 30-39.

Islam telah menjelaskan bahwa asal penciptaan manusia dari tanah. Darinya Allah menciptakan Adam yang merupakan bapak seluruh manusia. Allah Ta’ālā berfirman, “Sungguh, Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari saripati (berasal) dari tanah.” (QS. Al-Mu`minūn: 12)

Tujuan penciptaan manusia ialah beribadah kepada Allah Ta’ālā, meskipun Dia tidak membutuhkan makhluk-makhluk-Nya. Allah Ta’ālā berfirman, “Aku tidak menciptakan jin dan manusia melainkan agar mereka beribadah kepada-Ku.” (QS. Aż-Żāriyāt: 56)

passages.heading: Mengapa Kita Berzakat?
passages.text: Kita menunaikan zakat dalam rangka melaksanakan perintah Allah yang telah mewajibkannya kepada kita.

passages.heading: Harta Apa Sajakah yang Wajib Zakat?
passages.text:
- Emas dan perak
- Uang
- Hasil pertanian dan buah-buahan
- Hewan ternak
  Hewan ternak yaitu unta, sapi, dan kambing.
- Barang dagangan
  Barang dagangan maksudnya semua barang yang disiapkan dengan tujuan dagang, berupa rumah, toko, mobil, binatang, dan lain sebagainya.

passages.heading: Bagaimana Cara Kita Menunaikan Zakat Uang?
passages.text: Seorang Muslim menunaikan zakat pada hartanya yang berupa uang dan wajib zakat yaitu sekali setahun hitungan tahun hijriah. Kadar zakatnya 2,5% dan zakat tersebut diberikan kepada orang-orang fakir dan yang membutuhkan.

passages.heading: Pelajaran 2
passages.text:
*Ṣirāṭal-lażīna an’amta ‘alaihim gairil-magdūbi ‘alaihim walaḍ-ḍāllīn* [(Yaitu) jalan orang-orang yang telah Engkau beri nikmat kepadanya; bukan (jalan) mereka yang dimurkai dan bukan (pula jalan) mereka yang sesat]. Jalan tersebut ialah jalan orang-orang yang Engkau beri nikmat hidayah dari kalangan para nabi dan pembela mereka serta orang-orang yang berjalan di atas jalan mereka. Merekalah orang-orang yang diberi hidayah dan keistikamahan.

Jauhkanlah pula kami dari jalan orang yang Engkau murkai sebab mereka telah mengetahui kebenaran tetapi tidak mereka amalkan; juga dari jalan orang-orang tersesat yang tidak mendapatkan petunjuk ke jalan yang lurus karena kejahilan mereka.

passages.heading: Surah Al-Ikhlāṣ
passages.text:
{{Q:112:1-4}}

Makna surah:

Qul huwallāhu aḥad [Katakanlah, Dialah Allah Yang Maha Esa]. Katakanlah -wahai Rasul- kepada orang yang bertanya tentang sifat Tuhanmu: Dialah Allah Yang Maha Esa dalam ulūhiyah (keilahian) dan rubūbiyah (ketuhanan); tidak ada tuhan selain-Nya.

Allāhuṣ-ṣamad [Allah (Dia) yang bergantung kepada-Nya segala sesuatu]. Dialah Allah yang sempurna sifat-sifat-Nya dan tempat bergantung seluruh makhluk dalam meminta kebutuhan mereka disertai ketidakbutuhan-Nya ke mereka.

Lam yalid wa lam yūlad [Allah tidak beranak dan tidak pula diperanakkan]. Dialah Allah yang tidak memiliki anak, baik laki maupun perempuan, dan tidak pula memiliki orang tua, bapak ataupun ibu.

Walam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad [Dan tidak ada sesuatu pun yang setara dengan Dia]. Dia tidak memiliki tandingan di antara makhluk-Nya, baik pada zat, nama, sifat, maupun perbuatan-Nya.

passages.heading: Surah Al-Falaq
passages.text:
{{Q:113:1-5}}

Makna surat:

Qul a’ūżu birabbil-falaq [Katakanlah, Aku berlindung kepada Tuhan yang menguasai subuh]. Katakanlah -wahai Rasul-: Aku kembali dan aku berlindung kepada Allah, Tuhan yang menguasai al-falaq, yaitu waktu terbitnya fajar.

Min syarri mā khalaq [Dari kejahatan makhluk-Nya]. Dari kejahatan semua makhluk yang diciptakan-Nya, yang kami lihat maupun yang tidak kami lihat.

Wamin syarri gāsiqin iżā waqab [Dan dari kejahatan malam apabila telah gelap gulita]. Dari kejahatan malam ketika ia datang bersama kegelapannya serta semua yang ada padanya berupa keburukan dan hal yang menyakiti.

Al-Gasaq: gelap gulita malam

Al-Falaq: terbitnya fajar

passages.heading: Apa Zakat Itu?
passages.text: Zakat adalah mengeluarkan kadar tertentu dari harta orang-orang kaya kaum Muslim dan diberikan kepada orang-orang miskin di antara mereka. Zakat merupakan rukun Islam yang ketiga.
> Takdir ialah ketetapan Allah *Ta’ālā* pada segala sesuatu sejak zaman azali serta pengtahuan-Nya bahwa ia akan terjadi di zaman yang telah ditentukan di sisi-Nya dan menurut cara-cara tertentu.

passages.heading: Buah Keimanan
passages.text:
- Ketenangan jiwa; karena iman menjadikan jiwa seorang mukmin merasa tenang serta rida kepada Allah dan kepada takdir-Nya, ia tidak takut kecuali kepada Allah.
- Mengenal Allah *Ta’ālā*; yaitu orang yang beriman akan mengenal Tuhannya pada tingkat menambah keterikatannya dengan-Nya, sehingga ia bisa mengenal nama, sifat, dan perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya.
- Mengagungkan Allah; karena orang beriman itu, semakin ia mengenal Tuhannya maka akan semakin bertambah mengagungkan dan memuliakan-Nya, bertambah cinta dan harap kepada-Nya, dan bertambah takut kepada-Nya.
- Merasakan karunia Allah kepada hamba-hamba-Nya; yaitu Allah telah mengutus para rasul kepada mereka serta menurunkan kitab-kitab supaya mereka mendapat petunjuk kepada agama yang benar.
- Mencintai malaikat; karena ibadah dan ketaatan mereka kepada Allah.
- Mencintai para rasul; karena Allah *Ta’ālā* telah memilih mereka untuk menyampaikan agama-Nya kepada manusia.
- Bersungguh-sungguh dalam ibadah; karena semakin kuat tingkat keimanan, maka akan bertambah ibadah seseorang.
- Kehidupan yang baik; yaitu orang yang beriman akan rida dengan pembagian Allah untuknya. Dia mengetahui bahwa musibah yang menimpanya di dunia sebagai pengangkat derajatnya dan penghapus kesalahannya, sebagaimana ia mengharapkan kenikmatan surga yang Allah siapkan bagi orang beriman di akhirat.
- Tidak teperdaya dengan dunia; karena kehidupan dunia bersifat sementara dan merupakan sarana menuju kehidupan abadi di akhirat.
- Membongkar khurafat; karena keimanan membongkar banyak khurafat serta membatalkannya.
- Masuk surga yang merupakan negeri kenikmatan abadi yang tidak berhenti. Allah *Ta’ālā* telah mengkhususkannya bagi orang-orang yang beriman di antara hamba-Nya.

passages.heading: Akhlak dalam Islam
passages.text:
- Akhlak yang baik memiliki kedudukan agung dalam Islam karena merupakan salah satu tujuan besar syariat serta salah satu misi pengutusan Nabi Muhammad ﷺ.
- Akhlak memiliki korelasi kuat dengan iman, yaitu orang beriman yang paling sempurna imannya adalah yang paling bagus akhlaknya.
- Seorang Muslim akan diberikan pahala dengan akhlak baiknya sebagaimana ia diberikan pahala atas salat dan puasa.

passages.heading: Diskusikan!
passages.text: Bagaimana seharusnya akhlak seorang Muslim terhadap orang lain? Apakah akhlak ini memiliki pengaruh dalam menilai mereka di atas Islam?

passages.heading: Keutamaan Akhlak Baik
passages.text:
■ Nabi ﷺ mengabarkan bahwa amalan yang paling banyak memasukkan manusia ke surga ialah takwa kepada Allah dan akhlak baik.

■ Beliau ﷺ juga mengabarkan bahwa kebaikan terberat yang diletakkan di timbangan amalan manusia kelak hari Kiamat adalah akhlak baik.

■ Beliau ﷺ juga mengabarkan bahwa orang beriman yang paling dekat kedudukannya dari beliau kelak pada hari Kiamat adalah yang paling bagus akhlaknya.

> Timbangan amalan manusia akan ada pada hari Kiamat tatkala kebaikan dan keburukan manusia ditimbang pada timbangan khusus yang tidak ada seorang pun mengetahui bentuk dan ukurannya. Siapa yang mata timbangan kebaikannya lebih berat, ia akan masuk surga. Sebaliknya, orang yang mata timbang keburukannya lebih berat, ia akan masuk neraka.

passages.heading: Diskusikan!
passages.text:
Mengapa syahadat *"lā ilāha illallāh"* berkonsekuensi ingkar terhadap semua yang disembah selain Allah?

Ajaklah rekan-rekan Anda untuk menyebutkan berbagai faktor yang menjadikan sebagian orang bersemangat untuk menciptakan berbagai macam tuhan dan mengajak orang lain untuk menyembahnya!

Di antara dalil logis yang digunakan oleh Nabi Ibrahim *‘alaihissalām* untuk mendebat kaumnya ialah pertanyaanya kepada mereka: *"Apakah kamu menyembah patung-patung yang kamu pahat itu?"* (QS. Aṣ-Ṣāffāt: 95)

passages.heading: Normas relacionadas con la menstruación y el posparto.
passages.text:
Al-láh -Enaltecido y Exaltado sea- prescribe unas normas para la mujer menstruante y la en el período de postparto, de las cuales citamos:

■ No rezar, ya que la mujer menstruante no debe rezar en su período de postparto, y no tiene que recuperar los rezos después de su purificación.

■ No ayunar, ya que para la mujer menstruante o en su período de postparto no le está permitido ayunar, pero debe recuperar los días no ayunados después del mes de Ramadán.

■ La prohibición del coito, puesto que es prohibido para el hombre realizar el coito con su esposa estando en su período de menstruación o de postparto y solo se le permite el coito al terminar su período y después de que ella realice la ablución mayor. Está permitido para el esposo acariciar a su esposa en ambos períodos mencionados pero sin llegar a la penetración.

passages.heading: Exégesis de la sura:
passages.text:
(Di: “”¡Oh, incrédulos!)

Di- Oh mensajero- a quienes descreen a Al-láh y a Su mensajero: Oh incrédulos.

(No adoro lo que adoran.)

No adoro lo que adoráis de falsas deidades; como los ídolos y otros.

(Ni adoran ustedes a Quien yo adoro.)

Ustedes no adoran al Dios verdadero que yo adoro, el Único que merece ser adorado.

(Y jamás adoraré lo que adoran.)

Nunca adoraré los falsos dioses que adoran ustedes.

(Ni ustedes adoran a Quien yo adoro.)

Ni ustedes adoran al Dios verdadero quien adoro, el Único que merece ser adorado.

(Ustedes tienen su religión y yo la mía).

Ustedes están aferrados a su religión y yo permanezco aferrado a la mía.

> El incrédulo: es quien rechaza seguir el mensaje del profeta Muhammad -que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él-.

La mujer musulmana debe cubrir todo su cuerpo en presencia de:
a) Las demás mujeres.
b) Los hombres no parientes (no mahram).
c) El suegro (el padre del esposo).

La mujer después de la menstruación y del parto debe recuperar:
a) La oración.
b) El ayuno.
c) Todo lo mencionado anteriormente.

Tercero: Convertirse al Islam es el camino a la felicidad en esta vida y a la salvación en la otra vida, ya que no se salva en la otra vida sino quien al recibir el mensaje del profeta Muhammad -que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él- haya creído en él y le haya seguido, Al-láh-Enaltecido sea- dice: {{Q:3:85}} Corán (3: 85)

El profeta -que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él- dijo:» Juro por Aquel que posee mi alma en Su mano que, si una persona de este pueblo sea judío o cristiano, oye mi Mensaje y muere sin haber creído en él, será de la gente del infierno». Narrado por Muslim 153.

Cuarto: El Islam responde con respuestas evidentes a mis preguntas: ¿Por qué estoy en esta vida? ¿De dónde vine? y ¿A dónde iré después de la muerte?

passages.heading: ¿Cómo rezamos?
passages.text:
1. Tener la intención para la oración en su corazón (sin pronunciarla).
2. Ponerse de pie, dirigiéndose hacia la Quibla, levantando sus manos cerca de sus hombros o sus orejas diciendo: “”Al-láhu Akbar””.
3. Poner su mano derecha sobre la izquierda, luego decir la súplica de apertura de la oración (Istiftah) como:”””Glorificado seas Al-láh te alabamos. Bendito sea tu nombre y elevada sea tu majestad. No hay dios sino Tú””.Luego dice:(“”A’udhu bilahi mina shaytanir-rayim”” “”bismilahir-rahmanir-rahim””) es decir (“”Me refugio en Al-láh del maldito Satanás””, “”En el nombre de Al-láh el Clemente el Compasivo””).
Luego recita el capítulo de Al Fatiha y dice “”Amin”” (amén) después de acabarla, es decir: “”Oh Dios mío acepta mis súplicas””Luego recita algo que ha memorizado del Corán, aunque sea una sola aleya.
4. Levanta sus manos hasta sus hombros u orejas diciendo «»Al-láhu Akbar»» luego inclina su espalda poniendo sus manos sobre sus rodillas, estando su espalda y cabeza perpendiculares con sus piernas y dice durante su inclinación: «»Subhana rabial Adhim= Glorificado sea mi Señor Grandioso»» tres veces.

passages.heading: Exégesis de la sura:
passages.text:
(En el nombre de Dios, el Compasivo con toda la creación, el Misericordioso con los creyentes)

Empiezo la recitación del Corán con el nombre de Al-láh, pidiendo Su ayuda, Al-láh el Único que merece ser adorado, Quien posee la clemencia que abarca todas sus criaturas, el misericordioso con sus siervos creyentes ofreciéndoles una misericordia específica.

(Todas las alabanzas son para Dios, Señor de todo cuanto existe)

Alabar a Al-láh con los atributos perfectos, por Sus gracias sobre todas sus criaturas, es el Único que merece todo tipo de alabanza, es el Señor de todas las criaturas, Quien les creó de la nada,

passages.heading: La sura de Al Kauzar:
passages.text:
{{Q:108:1-3}}

**Exégesis de la sura:**

([¡Oh, Muhammad!] te he agraciado con la abundancia)

Te he agraciado -Oh mensajero- con un bien abundante e ilimitado en esta vida y en la otra, incluso con el río del Kawzar en el Paraíso.

(Reza a tu Señor y sacrifica [los animales en Su nombre].)

Dedica tu oración y tu sacrificio a tu Señor con sinceridad, adórale solo a Él sin asociarle nada ni nadie, sacrifica animales en Su nombre sin asociarLe nadie, para alabarLe por el bien y las gracias que te ofreció.

> Quien te desdeñe: es quien te odia, y odia la verdad que has transmitido a la gente.

(Porque a quien te desdeñe y odie le privaré de todo bien.)

Seguro que quien te desdeña y odia lo que te fue revelado de Verdad será el más desdeñado, humillado y privado de todo bien.

passages.heading: Normas relacionadas con la purificación:
passages.text:
- Los objetos en su origen son puros, y se considera impuro solo lo clasificado por las normas religiosas como tal.
- Es suficiente purificar el cuerpo o la vestimenta quitando las impurezas con agua o con algo que purifica.
- Al entrar al cuarto de baño para orinar o defecar, es preferible limpiar el sitio de la orina o de los heces con agua, y es permitido también quitar la suciedad y purificar el sitio con un papel higiénico u otro objeto que quite las impurezas.

passages.heading: Los tipos de sangre que sale de la mujer:
passages.text:
La sangre que sale de la mujer es de dos tipos:

| La sangre de la menstruación: | La sangre del postparto: |
| :--- | :--- |
| es un sangrado natural que sale del útero de la mujer generalmente cada mes, y dura unos días y se llama (menstruación). | es la sangre natural que sale del útero de la mujer después del parto del feto, y queda hasta 40 días (depende de cada mujer). |

passages.heading: Normas relacionadas con la menstruación y el posparto.
passages.text: ■ La ablución mayor (ghusl) cuando se detiene el sangrado, así es que cuando se termina el período de menstruación o del postparto la mujer debe realizar la ablución mayor (como fue explicado anteriormente).

passages.heading: A discutir
passages.text: Extrae algunos de los beneficios al reducir algunas obligaciones legales para la mujer en su período

passages.heading: La sura de An-Nas:
passages.text:
{{Q:114:1-6}}

**Exégesis de la sura:**

(Di: “”Me refugio en el Señor de los seres humanos,)

Di -Oh mensajero- me refugio en Al-láh Señor de la gente, el Todopoderoso.

(en el Rey Soberano de los seres humanos,)

El Rey Soberano de toda la gente, Quien maneja todos sus asuntos.

(en el [único] Dios de los seres humanos,)

El Dios de todos los seres humanos, entonces no hay nada ni nadie que merezca ser adorado fuera de Él.

(de la maldad del [demonio] susurrador que huye [cuando el nombre de Dios es mencionado],)

Contra el perjuicio del Satanás quien les susurra cuando dejan de recordar a Al-láh, y deja de susurrar cuando recuerdan a Al-láh.

(que susurra en los corazones de los seres humanos,)

El que esparce malos pensamientos en el pecho de las personas, y manipula sus sentimientos y pensamientos.

(ya sea que pertenezca a los yinn o a los hombres).

De los demonios de los genios y de los humanos.

passages.heading: A discutir
passages.text: ¿Qué tema enfatizaron las dos suras del Ijlas y la de Al Kafirun?

passages.heading: Segunda lección
passages.text: ## Exégesis de las suras cortas

El Islam obliga al hombre la manutención material de la mujer.

Verdadero Falso

No es una obligación de que el velo sea muy ancho.

Verdadero Falso

Cuando termina la menstruación, la mujer debe realizar la ablución mayor antes de rezar.

Verdadero Falso

Los loquios es la sangre que sale del útero de la mujer después del parto.

Verdadero Falso

passages.heading: The Position of Women in Islam
passages.text:
- Islam has granted women the right to inheritance, allocating them equitable shares with men, which sometimes differ under certain circumstances depending on their relationship with others and the financial obligations they have to discharge. While men support the family as a matter of religious obligation, women are not obliged to spend anything at all.
- It has established total equality between men and women in numerous matters including financial transactions.
- It has granted them the right to choose their own husbands.
- It has granted them the right to retain their maiden names. In Islam, a woman does not change her surname to that of her husband upon marriage; rather, she retains her maiden name, and thus her independent personality.
- It has made it the husband’s duty to spend on those women entitled to his support, such as his wife, mother and daughters, without attempting in the least to remind them of his favours.
- It stresses the importance of helping weak and vulnerable women who are in need of support, even if they are not one’s relatives, and urges its adherents to engage in such a noble act, which it considers one of the meritorious deeds in the sight of Allah.

passages.heading: The Position of Women in Islam
passages.text: Examples of rulings that honour and show respect to women in Islam:

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
With your partners, discuss the reasons why some types of clothing are forbidden in Islam.

The Prophet ﷺ forbade men from imitating women and women from imitating men. This prohibition includes the type of clothing and the manner of speech. Islam strictly forbids imitation of the opposite sex, considering it a major sin that invites Allah’s punishment unless one repents and desists from committing it. Islam enjoins men to ensure that their true nature and appearance are distinct from that of women, and vice versa, which clearly testifies to common sense and sound logic.

passages.heading: Why Do We Perform *Hajj*?
passages.text: Muslims perform *Hajj* to the Sacred House in Makkah in response to Allah’s command to do so.

passages.heading: Why Should I Embrace Islam?
passages.text:
Some people may ask: Why should I embrace Islam?

The answer is: I must do so for a number of reasons, including the following:

1. Islam is the religion that Allah has approved and chosen for His servants and will not accept any other religion. The Almighty says, {{Q:3:85}} (Soorat Aal-’Imraan, 3:85).

2. Islam is the religion of all the prophets and commands its adherents to believe in all of them without exception. Allah says, {{Q:2:136}} (Soorat Al-Baqarah, 2:136).
The difference between prophets lies only in the laws relating to people’s actions, as the Almighty says, {{Q:5:48}} (Soorat Al-Maa’idah, 5:48) That is, for each nation before Islam, Allah appointed a law to which people referred for their disputes and a way of life whereby they drew near to Him. Thus, followers of every prophet had their respective laws and regulations, but the set of beliefs to which prophets called their people was the same. Then Allah sent the last prophet and messenger, Muhammad ﷺ, with the final divine laws, and thus the only religion acceptable to Allah is Islam.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: People have always pondered the big questions of human existence: Where did we come from? Why are we here? Where do we go after death? Islam provides definitive and conclusive answers to these questions which arise in the heart of every reflective human being.

passages.heading: Why Do We Fast?
passages.text: Muslims fast in obedience to Allah Almighty and in response to His command.

passages.heading: Why Do We Pay *Zakaat*?
passages.text: We pay *zakaat* in compliance with the command of Allah who has enjoined us to pay it.

passages.heading: Lesson 5
passages.text: ## Islamic Rulings Pertaining to Muslim Women

passages.heading: Women in Relation to a Man
passages.text: Women in relation to a man fall into three categories:

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: Allah Almighty has bestowed some characteristics on women that distinguish them from men and enjoined on them certain acts of worship to the exclusion of men. In this lesson, we are going to learn about some rulings that pertain to Muslim women.

passages.heading: Forbidden Types of Clothing
passages.text:
A man's *'awrah* that must be covered extends from the navel to the knees. A woman must cover herself entirely in the presence of men not related to her; as for men to whom she is related and is forbidden to marry, such as her father, son and brother, she may appear before them as she would normally do in front of other women, showing such parts of her body as the face, hair, the neck and feet.

- Clothing that reveals the *'awrah* and does not conceal it
- Clothing that involves dressing like or imitating the opposite sex, such as when men dress like women and vice versa.
- Clothing that is worn with an air of pride and conceit
- Extravagant clothing
- Men are particularly forbidden to wear silk clothing or adorn themselves with gold or silver jewellery.
- Clothing that involves imitation of the dress traditionally worn by non-Muslims and specific to a certain religion, such as the type of clothing worn by monks and priests

passages.heading: Discuss
passages.text: Can we turn to fashion trends, customs, traditions or official regulations to determine for us what the appropriate clothing for men and women is?

passages.heading: ماذا أفعل إذا وجدت الماء بعد أن تيممت؟
passages.text: إذا وجد المسلم الماء أو قدر على استعماله انتقضت طهارته ووجب عليه الوضوء أو الغسل بعد ذلك .

passages.heading: كيف نصلي؟
passages.text:
إذا أراد المسلم أن يصلي فعليه القيام بالخطوات الآتية:

1. يستحضر نية الصلاة بقلبه.
2. يقف مستقبلًا القبلة، ويرفع كفيه بجوار كتفيه، ويقول: «الله أكبر».
3. يضع يده اليمنى على يده اليسرى. ثم يقرأ دعاء من أدعية الاستفتاح، مثل: «سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك، وتبارك اسمك، وتعالى جدك، ولا إله غيرك». ثم يقول: «أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم». ثم يقرأ سورة الفاتحة، ثم يقول: «آمين» عند الانتهاء من قراءتها، ومعناها: اللهم استجب دعاءنا. ثم يقرأ بعد الفاتحة ما تيسّر له مما يحفظ من القرآن الكريم، ولو كان آية واحدة.
4. يرفع يديه بجوار كتفيه أو أذنيه، ويقول: «الله أكبر»، ويحني ظهره راكعًا، ويضع يديه على ركبتيه، ويجعل ظهره ورأسه في مستوى واحد.

ويقول أثناء ركوعه: «سبحان ربي العظيم» ثلاث مرات.

passages.heading: سورة الفاتحة:
فضل قراءة القرآن:
passages.text:
- قال النبي ﷺ: «من قرأ حرفًا من كتاب الله فله به حسنة، والحسنة بعشر أمثالها، لا أقول: ﴿الم﴾ حرف، ولكن ألف حرف، ولام حرف، وميم حرف». أخرجه الترمذي في سننه (رقم 2910) بإسناد صحيح
- وقال النبي ﷺ: «اقرءوا القرآن، فإنه يأتي يوم القيامة شفيعًا لأصحابه». أخرجه مسلم في صحيحه (رقم 804)

passages.heading: ناقش
passages.text: ما الوسائل المعينة على حفظ سورة الفاتحة؟

passages.heading: تمهيد
passages.text: تعد سورة الفاتحة أعظم سور القرآن، وقد أكد رسول الله ﷺ على فضلها وعظمتها في أحاديث كثيرة، وهي السورة التي يجب على كل مسلم حفظها عن ظهر قلب؛ لكونها السورة الوحيدة التي يجب عليه تلاوتها أثناء صلاته، وفي هذا الدرس سنتعرف على هذه السورة ونحفظ آياتها ونتعلم معانيها ونتعرف كذلك على عدد من سور القرآن القصيرة والتي تضمنت معانٍ عظيمة.

10. بعد السجود الثاني في الركعة الثانية يجلس كجلوسه بين السجدتين، ويقول: «التحيات للَّه والصلوات الطيبات، السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته، السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين، أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله، وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله»، ويسمى التشهد الأول.

ثم يقول بعده: «اللهم صلِّ على محمد وعلى آل محمد، كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم، إنك حميدٌ مجيد، وبارك على محمد وعلى آل محمد، كما باركت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم، إنك حميدٌ مجيد» وتسمى الصلاة الإبراهيمية.

11. يلتفت عن يمينه ويقول: «السلام عليكم ورحمة الله» ثم يلتفت عن شماله ويقول مثل ذلك.

وبذلك تنتهي صلاته.

هذه الصفة إذا كانت صلاته ركعتان؛ كالفجر والجمعة، أما إذا كانت ثلاث ركعات؛ كالمغرب، أو أربع ركعات؛ كالظهر والعصر والعشاء، فإنه بعد الانتهاء من التشهد الأول يكمل ما تبقى من الركعات، ثم يجلس كما جلس بعد الركعة الثانية، ويقول التشهد الأول، ثم يقرأ الصلاة الإبراهيمية على النبي ﷺ، ثم يسلم.

passages.heading: درجات العبادات:
passages.text:
العبادات درجات متفاوتة:

- منها: ما يجب على كل مسلم كالصلاة مثلًا.
- منها: ما يجب على بعض المسلمين؛ كالزكاة تجب على الأغنياء دون الفقراء.
- منها: ما يستحب فعله ولا يجب، كالأدعية والأذكار التي تقال بعد الصلاة.

passages.heading: التيمم:
passages.text:
إذا عجز من أراد الوضوء أو الغسل عن فعل ذلك لعدم وجود الماء، أو للعجز عن استعمال الماء بسبب مرضٍ أو غيره، فيشرع له التيمم بدلًا عنهما .

**وصفة التيمم:** أن يضرب بيديه على التراب ضربة واحدة، ثم يمسح بما تبقى من أثر التراب في يديه على وجهه، ثم يمسح كفيه .

لابد من تعميم جميع البدن بالماء حتى يكون الغسل صحيحا رافعًا للجنابة.
صح  خطأ

لا يجب الغسل عند خروج المني حال النوم، ويجب عند خروجه حال اليقظة.
صح  خطأ

لا يجوز للجنب أن يجلس في المسجد.
صح  خطأ

يشرع التيمم للمسلم عند:
أ) العجز عن استعمال الماء.
ب) فقد الماء.
ج) جميع ما سبق.

passages.heading: الصلوات الخمس:
passages.text:
أوجب الله عز وجل على عباده أن يصلوا في اليوم والليلة خمس صلوات، وهي:

| صلاة العصر | مساواة ظل الشيء لطوله | غروب الشمس | ٤ |
